16febh-playful-feedback-toggle-buttons.summary:
A light-gray canvas (#f1f1f1) holds one centred pair of feedback buttons. Together they look like a pill split in two by a 12 px gap: the left half (thumbs-up) runs x 174–354 and the right half (thumbs-down) runs x 366–546, both y 294–426. Each half is 180×132. Its outer end is a full semicircle (radius ~66) and its inner corners are only slightly rounded (~8 px). The fill is an off-white #f7f7f7 with a hairline gray border and a soft drop shadow underneath. Each half holds a solid black glyph about 60 px across. The thumbs-up points up and right; the thumbs-down is its mirror. A black macOS-style arrow cursor with a white outline acts out four clicks:
1. **Like on, ~0.45s.** The left half shrinks to about 0.9 scale. From 0.65s to 0.95s the glyph turns dark green, grows to about 2× and leaps up out of the button, its top reaching y≈203. Meanwhile a mint radial glow fills the button.
2. **Glyph lands, 1.0–1.25s.** The glyph drops back, turns bright green (#0dbc39) and settles on the glow.
3. **Like off, ~1.85s.** The button shrinks again. The glyph darkens to deep green, then black, and the glow fades. The button is neutral by 2.35s.
4. **Dislike on, ~2.95s.** The cursor moves to the right half and clicks. The button shrinks, and from 3.05s to 3.35s the glyph goes dark red, then bright red (#e5173f). It wobbles in place (it does not fly), and a pink radial glow fills the button.
5. **Dislike off, ~4.15s.** A second click darkens the red glyph back to black and clears the glow. Everything is neutral by 4.6s.

The only moving parts are the cursor, the press scale, the glyph colour, scale and position, and the glow.

1wdmnr-collaborative-cursor-portfolio-in.summary: A portfolio intro staged as a live Figma-style canvas on a flat #f2f2f2 page. From 0 to about 4 s a single white artboard (#fdfdfd, 1 px blue #1e90ff selection outline with four small square white handles at its corners, a small blue "Portfolio" frame label above its top-left at x≈235 y≈271, and a blue pill dimension badge under the bottom edge) is resized by a purple multiplayer cursor labelled "Alim" from 1076 × 430 (0.5 s, box ≈234,288 → 1461,780) to 1100 × 440 (from about 1 s, box 234,288 → 1488,791). An orange cursor labelled "Client" sits under the artboard. Inside it the name "Alim Joldaspayev" types in letter by letter (≈1.0–1.9 s) as a very heavy, tightly tracked grotesk (~130 px cap height, near-black #0a0a0a, centred at x≈862, baseline ≈550) with a blue text caret, then a grey (#8a8a8a) subtitle "UX/UI Designer, Framer expert" types in under it (≈2.0–3.5 s, ~36 px, centred, y≈598–632). The Client cursor drifts up to x≈862 y≈678 meanwhile. A white rounded "Skip" button sits bottom-right at all times during the intro. Around 3.8–4.3 s the type fades to light grey and the artboard washes out to a full-white page, then at ≈4.45 s it cuts to the Works page: a 3D curved carousel of 17 project frames receding left and right in perspective (photo of a retro Mac on a sunset hill at far left, Meridian engraved-viaduct footer, dark Clasify panels at right), a centred tilted white "How this works" note card tucked into a pale envelope with a black "Got it" pill, a breadcrumb "Alim Joldaspayev / Works" top-left, and a white floating pill nav centred at the bottom ("Works" active in blue, About, Contact, ‹ 1/17 ›, ?). The Client cursor clicks "Got it" at ≈7.2 s; at ≈8.7–9.3 s the card drops away and the first frame "Offline / 404" swings out of perspective to face the viewer flat at 337,175 → 1363,815 with a blue selection outline and "View on X ↗" chip below; a video plays inside it (TV colour bars appear, clouds spell "404"). Every ≈1.3–1.5 s afterwards the carousel slides left one frame (10.5–11.4 s to Meridian / Footer 2/17, 11.9–12.6 s to Driftline / Integrations 3/17, and on through QED, desert, pixel-grid motion spheres), the counter incrementing, the Alim cursor riding the active frame's bottom-right handle. Around 21 s the page switches to About: a portrait card "Hi, I'm Alim.", a bio paragraph "I create modern digital experiences for startups, SaaS, AI, fintech, and personal brands.", stat cards "30+ / 62+ / $25M" and an experience card, which slide in and enlarge through the end.

1apkr1-ai-thinking-process-ui.summary: A single left-aligned agent-trace column on a flat #e9e9e9 field, no card or chrome. A 20px gutter of status icons sits at x≈163 and the text column starts at x=215 (Inter-like sans, ~21px, #1f1f1f for the active line, mid-grey ~#6b6b6b for finished steps, light grey ~#a0a0a0 for side-branch steps). The top row is a chevron plus "Thinking" with a grey seconds counter (0s→13s) that ends as "Thought for 14s". The first step, "Searching the codebase", has a row of white pill chips (TS router.ts, TS auth.ts, a React-atom Button.tsx, a globe "Routing – Next.js docs") and a grey "+3 more". The steps go down in rows about 55px apart and are joined by a 1px grey rail at x≈163. Side branches (dead end, test runs) bend out to an indented sub-rail at x≈193 on a curved, sometimes dashed connector. Motion is a steady narration. About every 1.4s the active step's text switches to its past tense and turns grey, and its icon goes from a spinning arc to a small dot, ring, magnifier or ×. A new active row then fades in from a blur under it, and the whole stack moves up about 27px in roughly 150ms (ease-out) so it stays vertically centred. The active line and the word "Thinking" carry a light shimmer that sweeps across the letters. The chips stagger in left to right around 0.6–1.0s. At about 14.1s the trace ends: "Drafted a 3-step refactor plan", a blue check with "Finished thinking", the grey note "4 modules to deepen · 3 steps" fading in, and the header changing to "Thought for 14s". The end state holds to 16s.

1b68k7-bee-garden-progress-slider.summary: A single slider centred on a flat near-black stage (#181818, 1480x720). Across the top runs a header row: "Garden" on the left (x 209, baseline about y 222, ~24px regular sans, light grey) and a percentage on the right, right-aligned at x 1262, the same size but dimmer grey. About 225px below sits a thin dark-grey track (#262626, ~4px tall, rounded ends) from x 232 to about x 1238. A thicker sage-green fill (#6b8f6a, ~6px, rounded caps) grows from x 232 to the drag position. Along the fill a flat-illustrated garden grows: a row of short grass tufts on the line, and flowers on thin green stems with leaf pairs, up to ~150px tall (tops near y 282): yellow tulip, coral poppies with dark centres, white daisies with yellow centres, purple lavender spikes, blue forget-me-not clusters, pink round blooms with dark centres, pink tulips, lilac asters, a pink dahlia. A bee emoji (~40x45) sits on the line at the leading edge of the fill as the thumb and follows the pointer with a little lag. Motion is the cursor dragging: going right, the fill and the number rise together, bare stems shoot up just ahead of the bee and their heads open a beat later, left to right. Going left, the fill shrinks, the flowers past the thumb drop their petals, which scatter up and to the right and fade over ~0.5s, and the stems shrink back down. The clip goes 3% → 34% (0–2.5s), → 68–69% (~3.9–4.5s), back to 24% (~4.6–5.7s, with petals scattering), jumps to 100% (~5.9–6.6s; the whole row sprouts as bare stems, then blooms), drags back to ~70% (~7.2–9.3s), then forward to 98% by 12s.

b0jj7f-gpu-pods-card-animation.summary: A centred 1080×1080 light composition: a #eeeeee backdrop with a faint 3×3 grid of hairlines (x≈234/847, y≈234/847). It holds one off-white card (#f9f9f9, ~16px radius, soft white rim and very soft shadow) at [293,286,494,509]. Inside the card's top is an inset illustration panel [302,295,476,291] with a barely visible 1px border. It shows a skeuomorphic grey GPU: a brushed-silver rounded board [370,382,237,100] with two dark 7-blade fans in grey rings, four dark corner screws, and white heatsink fin strips peeking above and below. A row of tiny tick dots runs above it, and a long soft drop shadow falls toward the lower right. A short black cable runs from the right side into a small square port plate with four screws and a dark round socket. Below, left-aligned at x=321, sit the black semibold title "GPU Pods", two lines of mid-grey body copy, and a dark near-black gradient "Deploy Pod" button (~8px radius, white label, soft drop shadow). Motion: at 0s the panel is empty. From ~0.1s to 0.3s a pale, flat, low-contrast GPU fades in with its tick rows. Around 0.3–0.5s a pale port plate and cable appear to the right. From ~0.5s to 1.0s the drawing gains depth: fans darken, screws, fins and shadow appear, the cable turns black, and the plate settles ~5px left to x≈645. From then to 7.8s the only motion is both fans spinning continuously. Card, text and button never move.

1lnwpl-krea-agent-onboarding-flow.summary: A Krea desktop app window (1460x900 at 90,90, ~16px radius, white #fcfcfc) sits centred on a flat #e8e8e8 page. For the first 22.5s the app behind is blurred and greyed and a centred onboarding modal (469,321, 703x439, ~24px radius, white) floats over it. The modal is split in two. The left half is a 345x428 image panel inset 6px with ~16px radius. The right half holds the copy, with a close × top-right, a secondary button bottom-left and a black primary button bottom-right. Step 0 'Welcome to Krea Agent' (0–8.55s): the left panel is a pale blue-mint gradient with a white pill prompt ('Design a campaign', black + button). Its text types itself and cycles ('Restyle this look' by 8.3s). Dozens of colourful artwork cards (paintings, toys, a red head, a pasta tin, a tennis racket) drift slowly over the blurred backdrop and across the panel. At 8.55s the modal cuts to step 1 '1 of 2 Connect your tools'. The floating art vanishes. The left panel becomes a soft blue-to-lilac gradient with small white app-icon tiles (Slack, Gmail, Notion, GitHub, YouTube, OneDrive) scattered in an arc around a pill that reads 'Use [G-Drive] G-Drive assets'. The right column lists Notion / Slack / G-drive rows with + buttons and a 'Browse apps' link. During ~12–17s the modal shows the expanded full-width app browser: a search field and a two-column grid of 8 apps (Linear checked). It then returns. Around 17.5s it moves to step 2 '2 of 2 Upload your assets' with a lilac-pink photo collage, an asset-check pill ('Check assets from 📁 SS26 Supreme') and a 'Let's go' button. At ~22.55s the modal disappears and the blur lifts within about 0.1s, leaving the sharp home screen. It has a left icon rail and a misty sea image, the heading 'What do you want to create this afternoon?', a large rounded composer, a right panel of Files/Generations/Skills/New side chat rows, and a 4-up Templates row. From 23.85s to 24.65s the page scrolls ~665px into a dense grid of template photos while the composer docks at the bottom (y 876–978). A hovered card shows a dark caption 'Bakery Rebrand'. From 25.0s to 26s the page scrolls back to the top.

14scng-flashnet-network-landing-page.summary: A light hero (#fcfcfc) sits above a pale grey band (#f7f7f7, y 958–1080). On the left, starting at x=288, is a two-line headline at about 60px: "The network of networks." in near-black, with "Flashnet unifies everything." in mid-grey (#7a7a7a) below it. Lower down is a 3-line grey body paragraph (y≈693–757) and a flat light-grey "Read the docs" button (289,793,130,38). The right side holds a network diagram drawn in perspective. A small white disc carrying the black Flashnet bolt logo sits at about (1437,866). Thin pale-mint spokes radiate from it, and faint mint concentric ellipses surround it. Four 3D rounded-square chain tiles sit on an arc above the disc: a front slot at (888,540), then (1143,453), (1443,420) and (1742,456), each tile tilted in perspective and casting a soft drop shadow. A bright mint double line runs from the upper left, through the front tile, to the centre logo. A small white pill label above the front tile names the chain. About every 4s the tiles rotate one slot counter-clockwise along the arc, which takes about 0.35s (at 1.75–2.15, 5.8–6.15 and 9.8–10.1). The old front tile fades to grey and drops down-left out of view, a new tile slides in from the right edge, and the label disappears and then comes back with the new name: Ethereum → Lightning → Solana → Tron. During each hold, mint rings pulse outward from the centre disc, short mint dashes travel along the spokes, and the label appears about 1.5–2s after the tiles settle. The text, button and centre logo never move.

10qjw2-ai-node-based-workflow-canvas.summary: A dark node-graph canvas (#131516 with a faint dot grid about 37 px apart) shown wide: a Prompt node top-left (89,119, 310x236) with an inset text box, a "Random noise" node cut off by the left edge (0,318, 249x140), a Sampler node below (161,451, 309x139), and a Processing node on the right (609,105, 322x300) with three input ports (conditioning, noise, sampler) on its left edge and a grey "Awaiting inputs" status line. Cards are #1d1e20-ish, radius about 16 px, with a 1 px lighter border and a soft drop shadow. Type is a light-grey sans: titles white about 15 px semibold, labels grey about 13 px. Output ports are white dots 12 px across on each card's right edge. The clip is a cursor wiring sequence with camera cuts. At 0.4s it cuts to a 1.7x close-up of the Processing input column. A white cable is dragged from Prompt's conditioning port, and a yellow zig-zag lightning spark jumps from the cable tip to the target port, which shows a yellow ring. On release (~1.0s) the cable and both port dots turn yellow, the target gets a double ring, and a yellow glow sweeps along Processing's left edge. At ~1.55s it cuts back to wide, and a yellow check appears at the right of the conditioning row. The noise cable repeats this in pink (~2.65–2.95s, pink check), then the sampler cable in purple (~4.1–4.25s), after which the status reads "All inputs ready". At ~5.0s it cuts to the close-up again, and cables are re-dragged and re-snap in new colours: conditioning turns orange (~5.75–6.15, orange glow, "All inputs ready"), noise turns cyan (~6.45–7.75), then noise turns yellow (~7.95–8.75). While a cable is being dragged it is white and the status falls back to "Awaiting inputs". Each colour comes with a glow sweep around the Processing card edge.

1yi26a-accordion-faq-interaction.summary: A centred FAQ section on a warm off-white page (#e5e1d9, lighter towards the top centre). It has a bold near-black title "Frequently asked questions" and a grey one-line subtitle, and below them a realistic red piano accordion about 773 px wide. The top red marbled panel holds a 15-white / 10-black key keyboard in a black rounded frame. The bellows are the FAQ itself: five white rounded question cards stacked at a 65 px pitch, with dark fold lines between them, taupe metallic chevron pleats on both sides and a silver pill stud on each fold. The bottom red marbled panel carries a cream parallelogram plate of 48 domed black bass buttons (4×12). Silver corner caps sit on all four corners, and a dark stitched leather strap with a soft shadow hangs underneath. The whole block stays vertically centred, so it re-centres as it grows. Motion: the clip opens on a squeezed accordion (cards are thin strips). It springs open from 0.37 to 0.72 s, overshooting to 587 px and settling at 572 px by 1.05 s, while the question text fades in from the top down. At 2.05 s the strap is dragged down, which stretches the bellows from the top (bottom panel +114 px, fold gaps widen). On release at 2.5 s it snaps back past rest to a compressed 400 px at 2.82 s, rebounds to 646 px and settles at ~578 px by 3.4 s. Items then open one at a time, each symmetric about the centre (title rises ~15 px per open): refunds at 3.8 s, cancel at 4.5 s, plan at 5.25 s. On each open the + rotates into a −, the grey answer fades in, chord keys tint on the keyboard, and for the third open an "E minor 7" pill appears. The state holds from 5.4 to 9.1 s, with only the red marble flowing. The items close in reverse order (9.15, 9.6, 10.1 s). The cursor plays keys (11–12 s). A second stretch runs from 13.25 to 13.8 s, then the accordion collapses fully to the squeezed state (14.0–14.25 s), holds until 14.8 s, and springs open again with overshoot to 609 px, settling at 574 px by 15.3 s.

zwq08-spotlight-signup-form.summary: A single dark signup card sits centred on a near-black (#0b0b0b) canvas ruled with a faint 152 px grid of thin grey lines and edge tick marks. The card [245,216,585,650] is a slightly lighter charcoal (#161616–#181818) with ~40 px corners and a soft 1 px lighter rim. Inside, left-aligned at x=301: the white semibold heading "Let's create your account" (~32 px), then three label+input pairs ("Full Name", "Work Email", "Password", grey ~15 px labels) with near-black 472x56 inputs of ~8 px radius and grey placeholders, and a full-width silver gradient "Sign Up" button (472x56) with dark semibold text. Two small outline stage-spotlight lamps hang from the card's top corners (about x 262–310 and 762–812, y 226–295), hung from a small bracket on a thin line. Motion: at ~1.05–1.25 s the cursor clicks Full Name; both lamps swing inward and switch on, throwing warm amber volumetric cones with drifting dust specks onto the focused input, which turns a warm gold-tan with a bright top edge highlight, while everything else (heading, other labels, inputs, the Sign Up button) dims to ~30–40% brightness and a brief warm horizontal flash line crosses the card at y≈277. "Tushti Sachdeva" is typed letter by letter (~2.2–5.3 s). At ~5.3–5.5 s focus jumps to Work Email: the lamps re-aim steeper, the cones now land on the email field, the name field returns to dark with dimmed text. "contact@tushti.fyi" is typed (~5.6–11.3 s). At ~11.5–11.65 s focus jumps to Password; the lamps aim almost straight down and the cones hit the password field; 10 dots are typed (~11.8–13.4 s). At ~13.45 s the Sign Up button snaps back to bright silver while the lights remain on. At ~14.75–14.9 s the lights fade out (cones turning a dimmer orange as they go), the password field goes dark, and every text and the heading return to full brightness; the lamps return to unlit outlines. The card itself never moves.

i61wwn-painterly-finance-app-onboarding.summary: A single mobile screen centred on a near-white (#fdfdfd) canvas: a rounded phone panel (656,200 → 970,883, corner radius ~40 px) filled edge to edge with an oil-painting landscape. It has a pale beige-teal sky at the top, a dark green tree mass on the right with a brown trunk running down the centre, purple hills on the left and yellow-green foliage at the lower left. Across the painting, concentric water-like ripples spread from one point at the spinner (~812,650). Each ring bends and offsets the painted strokes, with a faint bright crest along its leading edge and no drawn stroke. The rings travel outward continuously at about 60 px/s, ~100 px apart, so a new crest leaves the centre about every 1.7–1.9 s. This runs the whole 24 s, and the rest of the screen holds still. The foreground UI is static and centred on x≈812. A small translucent light disc (~68 px) sits at ~812,650 and holds a white 8-spoke spinner icon with a dark centre dot. The spinner does not rotate. Below it sits a translucent, slightly lightened rounded card (674,648, 277×158, radius ~22) whose top edge passes behind the spinner disc. The card holds three centred lines of ~13 px white body copy. At the bottom is a solid white pill button (674,824, 277×44) labelled "Get Started" in ~13 px dark medium-weight type. Type is a neutral grotesk (Inter-like).

77izkq-frosted-glass-hero-wordmark.summary: A light monochrome studio hero on an off-white (#fbfbfb) pane of fogged glass, faintly speckled with condensation rings across the whole frame. Top bar: "Northline Studio" at top-left (x43,y47), a centred hint "◉ WIPE THE GLASS" in small letterspaced grey caps, and "Work  Studio  Contact" at top-right. The centre is a huge heavy grotesk wordmark "Northline" (about 113–1742 px wide, cap top y≈316, baseline y≈598). It starts frosted: grey, heavily blurred, about 30–40 px soft edges, with dark and light droplet dots on the letters. Bottom-left: a 2-line near-black headline about 50 px tall, "Websites and digital products, / designed around how people use them.". Below it are a black pill "Start a project →" and an outlined white pill "See the work". Bottom-right: a status line with a black dot, "Taking projects for 2027", over a live clock "Mumbai 19:58:xx IST" that ticks each second. Bottom-centre: a white floating pill segmented switcher "01 Gather | 02 Frost | 03 Liquid | 04 Meridian", where "02 Frost" is the active black pill. Motion: from 0 to about 9.9 s a water drip at x≈800 runs slowly down through the "r/t" of the wordmark. It leaves a sharp black jagged line (a clear trickle) with a white highlight above it. By 4.95 s it reaches y≈590, and a second drip later forms at x≈1475 through the "n". Around 9.95–10.2 s the "WIPE THE GLASS" hint fades out and the user starts wiping. The cursor, a thin grey 64 px ring, drags across the wordmark. Each pass clears a soft-edged blob of frost to bright white, showing the crisp solid black (#141414) wordmark underneath. Cleared areas stay clear. By 12.75 s "orthlin" is clear. By 15.4 s the whole wordmark is sharp and only faint wipe edges remain in the fog. Nothing else moves; the layout stays fixed.

dkolso-self-building-website-cursors.summary: A 30 s screen recording on a near-white canvas (#f7f9fb). From 0 to about 3.4 s, 18 small coloured cursor arrows (purple, red, salmon, orange, yellow, green, teal, sky and blue) orbit loosely around a pale grey rounded-square "S" logo (#d7dae0, 920,491,80×93) at frame centre. The ring stays about 330 px wide (x≈750–1160, y≈340–720) and keeps reshuffling into arcs. Each cursor is a filled arrowhead about 18 px across with a white outline and a soft shadow. A black system pointer sits still near the top right (≈1780,165). At about 3.45 s the scene becomes a design-tool canvas: a dark ruler band runs along the top (0–27 px) and the left edge, with blue selection boxes, size badges ("580 × 130", "53 × 20"), dotted guides and two red vertical guides at x≈261 and x≈1120–1141. The cursors build a SaaS landing page called "Swarm". They type the text letter by letter with I-beam cursors, draw boxes with crosshair and pen cursors, duplicate placeholder "Product" and "agent/research" labels, then retype them into their final words. The finished hero (rulers gone by 7.8 s) has: a nav bar (Swarm logo, the links Product / Agents / Docs / Pricing, and a black "Get access" button); a two-line 80 px headline, "Run a thousand agents as one."; a grey subline; a black "Start building" button and a white "Read the docs" button; and on the right a dark "swarm.dispatch(task)" panel above a 2×2 tree of four white agent cards, a blue progress bar about 65 % full, and a mono caption. A "Used by teams at" row of five wordmarks sits in a 224 px grid. After 8.35 s the page scrolls up in steps and the cursors keep building the next sections: "Built for running agents in production." with a 3×2 grid of feature cards (duplicated as "Smart routing", then retyped), "One file describes the whole swarm." with a dark swarm.yaml code window, a stats row ("10k+ 38ms 99.99% 0"), "How a task moves through Swarm." (Define / Dispatch / Converge), and "Priced by the size of your swarm." with a "$0" plan card. Thin light-grey grid lines frame every section, and a red vertical guide at x≈261 stays visible throughout the build.

ewfwo2-tooltip-hover-delay-comparison.summary: A light, quiet comparison demo on a #f4f4f4 page: two identical white cards stacked (top [48,48,1344,480], bottom [48,552,1344,480], ~40px corner radius). Each card has a handwritten-script title at top-left ("Delay on every hover" in magenta, "Delay once, then instant" in mint green), a grey "N.Ns waiting" counter at top-right, a centred floating white formatting toolbar (691x78, ~18px radius, soft drop shadow) holding Body▾ | B I U S | link code quote | a coloured dot (magenta on top, mint on bottom), and a full-width 10px grey timeline track near the card bottom. Only one card is active at a time; the other sits at ~30% opacity. 0–7.8s the top card runs: an arrow cursor enters, turns into a pointing hand, and hovers B, I, U, S, link, code, quote left to right (~0.9s per button). Each hover shows a light-grey hover square, a small blue spinner ring plus a light-blue pill counting down "500ms"→"0ms" beside the cursor, then a near-black tooltip ("Bold ⌘B", "Italic ⌘I", …) fades in above the button; the previous tooltip lingers grey as it fades out. y9mnpy-sheet-animation-keyframe-explorat.summary: A near-black canvas (#0f100d) split into two columns. On the left, a monospace code editor with no chrome: 18 right-aligned line numbers (x≈108–140) and CSS code starting at x=192, line pitch ≈51 px, type ≈30 px. The code is `@keyframes sheet-in { 0% { transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: translateY(-4%); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(0%); } } .sheet { animation: sheet-in 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); }`. Only the lines inside a "focus band" are legible. The band is marked by two blue dotted rules running x=78→975. Inside it, line numbers turn blue, property names are bold off-white, values are grey and numbers/percentages are blue. Every line outside the band is shown as dim, scrambled random characters. As the band moves, characters scramble and then decode into real code. A white up/down resize cursor drags the band's edge. On the right, a phone outline (1050,83, 329×922, radius ≈60, grey 2 px stroke) holds six grey placeholder bars and two faint dotted guide lines at y≈447/468. Between the editor and the phone, a thin vertical timeline ruler at x≈1008 (y 238→648, end caps and a middle tick) carries a short blue dash that shows the scrub position. A second short blue dash at x≈1388–1404, right of the phone, tracks the sheet's top edge. A bottom sheet (308 px wide, rounded top, light-grey outline, #151614 fill, grabber bar, one bright title bar and two grey bars) is driven by the band. With the band on the 0% block the sheet is hidden. When the band is dragged to the 60% block (≈2.05–2.75 s) the sheet slides up from below to top≈449, overshooting. On the 100% block and `.sheet` rule (≈4.8–6.3 s) it settles to top≈467. The band then scrubs back and forth (7.85–9.05, 10.05–11.2, 11.55 s) with the sheet tracking 449–467. Finally (13.0–13.75 s) the band jumps back to the 0% block and the sheet slides back down out of the phone.

mr8l2d-mobile-access-key-product-page.summary: A dark product-page section recorded as a screen capture. A near-black rounded panel (#1b1b1e, about 90,90 to 1487,990, radius ~16) floats over a deep indigo wallpaper of soft curved folds with violet rim light. Two faint vertical hairlines run down the panel at x≈148 and x≈1418, and a dashed hairline runs across at y≈114. At the top centre are three text tabs: "Corporate ID" (active, white, 82px white underline above it at y≈113), "Multifamily" and "Hospitality" (grey). Below them is a large media stage (#28272e, 174,162 to 1392,763, slightly lighter than the panel), then a four-column row of feature blurbs: each has a small line icon at y≈815, a white bold lead-in and a grey body at 14–15px with 24px line height. The active blurb's body brightens to near white, and a small circular progress ring in its top-right corner fills as a timer. The stage content follows the active blurb. Card 1 (0–1.5s) shows a grey soft-plastic key fob with a slot and inset disc, with soft rings pulsing outward. At ~1.5s the cursor lands on card 4 "Biometrics on device", the fob cuts away and the stage goes empty. From 2.45–2.65s the recording zooms hard into the stage with motion blur until it fills the frame, and a halftone point-cloud head builds from scattered dots and slowly turns (2.6–7.3s). From 7.3–7.75s the camera zooms back out to the page while the dotted head fades out of the stage (gone by ~9.3s). At ~11.75s card 3 "Upgrade your keys" becomes active, and the stage fills with a three-column grid of dark rounded ID cards with scrambled monospace labels. The centre column scrolls vertically and the centred card lights up as a frosted grey glass card with a building line-drawing, a logo, an NFC glyph and "Finance / Maximilian Thompson". At ~14.2–14.65s it dims and the column scrolls one card, and the next card lights up as "Product / Emma Williams".

87b7ma-brain-effort-dial-knob.summary: A single skeuomorphic control knob centred slightly below the middle of a square 1080 canvas, on a near-black charcoal (#202022) page. A faint 1px grey grid with ~114px cells covers the top ~640px and fades out toward the bottom. The knob is a matte black disc ~410px across (centre ≈540,555). Around its top 270° runs a ring of about 48 short radial tick marks, with two small separate stop marks at about 7:30 and 4:30 o'clock beside the bottom label. Inside sits a recessed dark collar and a glossy black glass dome ~244px across. The dome has a soft white specular cap at its top and thin bright crescents on its left and right rims. Floating in the dome is a slowly turning 3D brain. A small bold all-caps grey label (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, X-HIGH, MAX, GALAXY, SMOOTH) sits at the bottom of the bezel at y≈723. Dragging with a grab-hand cursor sets the effort level, and every change happens in place. Ticks light orange-red (#ff4a1a with glow) clockwise from the bottom-left in proportion to the level: 1 tick at LOW, about half at HIGH, all of them at MAX. Each level also changes the brain and the dome. LOW is a dark-blue glassy brain on black. MEDIUM is a violet brain on a purple sparkly dome. HIGH is an electric-blue brain with white lightning bolts on navy. X-HIGH is a cyan holographic brain on a teal dome. MAX is a pale pink-white brain on a warm translucent-amber dome with rotating light shafts and drifting specks. Dragging past MAX gives GALAXY: a cyan brain, the bezel goes semi-transparent, and huge blurred teal light rays burst out to ~350px around the knob (4.65–6.1s and again ~15s). Dragging below LOW gives SMOOTH: an unlit tick ring, the left stop mark lit white, and a smooth glossy pink blob brain. Timeline: LOW 0–1.5s, sweep up through MEDIUM (~1.6s), HIGH (~2.2s), X-HIGH (~2.9s), MAX (~3.6s), GALAXY burst 4.65–6.1s, MAX 6.1–7.3s, drag down through X-HIGH and HIGH (7.3–7.65s) to SMOOTH (~8–9.5s), LOW ~9.6–14s with a brief SMOOTH flick ~12.4s, back up through MEDIUM and X-HIGH to GALAXY ~14.9–16.2s, then MAX, X-HIGH and HIGH (~17.1s on). HIGH holds with crackling lightning to 21.5s. The knob itself never moves or resizes.

7npk6z-x-subscription-modal-design.summary: A centred white modal (371,158 → 1233,922; ~24px radius, no visible border, soft shadow) sits over an X Premium settings page dimmed by a flat mid-grey scrim (#a2a2a2 over the page). The page underneath reads clearly through the scrim: X left nav (Home…More, bold 'Subscription', dark 'Post' pill), a centre column (Premium, 'Verified since February 2024', Quick access, Upgrade to unlock, rows) and a right column (Help Center / Get support / Manage your subscription, a colourful Grok-blob illustration card, a dark hero image card). The modal is centred on x≈802: close × at top right, a bold black 30px title 'Introducing the X Subscription', a grey subtitle, a hairline divider broken by the label 'The Ultimate AI Subscription', then three equal light-grey rounded preview cards (~256×268, ~20px radius) each holding a product mark at top-left and a cropped product mockup (X post with rocket photo and a 'Premium' chip; Grok agent list with a coffee photo; Cursor code diff 'hero.tsx' with a prompt box), with centred captions underneath. Below sit a light-grey rounded info bar with a gauge icon and a blue 'Learn more' link, a full-width-ish black pill 'Get started' (551,802, 502×42) and two lines of small grey legal text. Nothing enters or exits: the modal, scrim and page are static for the whole 8.62s. The only motion is a hover effect driven by the mouse pointer: when the pointer is over a card, that card's inner mockup drifts up/left by about 4–6px (X card at ~2.5s: post rises 6px, Premium chip shifts 5px left and 4px up; Grok card at ~3.7–4.8s: agent list rises 4px, coffee photo shifts ~2px left/3px up) and returns when the pointer leaves; the Cursor card shows no visible shift. Small avatars in the Grok list change expression (eyes blink).

1knz9n-hamster-cookie-consent-modal.summary: A single white rounded card (360x511 at x180,y104, ~28px radius, very soft wide grey shadow) is centred on a flat #efefef page. The card is centre-aligned on top: a bold black "Cookie settings" title (~24px) and a grey ~13px subtitle "Every cookie you accept goes to the hamster", then a painterly cartoon hamster illustration (~224x218 plate, x248,y192, near-white backing that barely differs from the card). Below sit three settings rows (Analytics, Marketing, Personalization) with 14px dark labels on the left at x209 and iOS-style toggles on the right (x472-511, ~39x23), separated by 1px hairlines at y426/464/502/540 spanning x209-511. The footer holds a black pill "Accept all" button (x209,y560,109x35, white bold text) and a grey text link "Reject all". Motion is a story driven by a pointer cursor: at ~1.1s the cursor clicks Analytics, its toggle slides on and turns green, a round chocolate-chip cookie (~52px) pops out beside the toggle and flies left/up into the hamster's paws (by ~1.43s), the hamster lifts it to its mouth and eats (1.7-2.6s) and ends with a timid smile and slightly fuller cheeks (3.15s). At ~3.55s Marketing is clicked: same toggle-on + cookie flight (3.65-3.98s), the hamster eats with eyes closed (4.63s) then bursts into an open-mouthed grin with big puffed cheeks and raised paws (5.3s) and yellow sparkle strokes flicker beside its head (5.6s). At ~6.25s Personalization is clicked: a third cookie flies to the belly (6.7s) and the hamster ends with huge balloon cheeks, sparkly eyes and yellow sparkles (7.6s). Around 8.6s the cursor hovers "Reject all" (its text darkens from grey to near-black), clicks at ~9.35s: all three toggles turn off together and the hamster deflates back to the original sad pose (9.35-9.75s). The card, text, rows and buttons never move; only the toggles, the cookie, the hamster artwork, the link colour and the cursor change.

1mevqv-byanat-classical-art-landing.summary: A handheld phone recording of a monitor, filmed at a steep angle from lower left, so every line of the page rises toward the right. The page is a full-bleed hero. Its background is a cinematic, AI-animated "Creation of Adam" video: Adam reclines on rocks at left under a blue cloudy sky, and God sits in a red mantle at right. Their fingers almost touch at about (515,525). A dark gradient covers the lower ~40%, fading to near-black behind the copy. Overlay, top left: a faint white "Byanat" wordmark with a rounded-square icon. Three small nav links follow the skewed top edge: "Products", "Customers", "Partners". A tiny white pill button sits at the far top right (~748,430). Lower left holds a white rounded "Backed by [Y] Combinator" badge. Under it is a large white serif two-line headline, "AI for infrastructure / that cannot fail.", then a three-line white sans paragraph. The macOS dock and the browser tab bar are visible on the monitor. The room wall with an iron clock fills the top-right corner. The overlay never moves except for the slight jitter of the handheld camera; all the motion is in the background video. 0-0.6s: a near-still wide shot. 0.7-5.6s: the camera dollies in on God; by 3.15s his bearded face fills the right half, and around 4.5-5.6s his hair sweeps past dark and blurred. 5.7-11.8s: a photoreal live-action scene of a young man on a rocky cliff reaching toward the camera. 11.9-12.5s: a whip to a close shot of his back and outstretched arm against the sky. 12.6-16.7s: the camera pulls back to the painted composition, with God returning at right. 17-20s: the shot settles into the opening framing (a seamless loop) with only camera shake.

89svt1-dreamy-meadow-reading-hero.summary: A full-bleed 1912x1080 hero over a photoreal 3D render of rolling green grass hills under a pale blue sky with soft cumulus clouds at left (0-330, y 405-615) and right (1600-1912, y 370-550). The sky fades to near-white #eef2f7 at the top so the type reads. Top left: a two-line tight-tracked semibold heading "A quiet place for / a loud internet" (x 86, cap top ~100, about 62px type, dark slate in day), with a two-line grey subcopy at y 240-295 under it. Top right: a 3-column, 4-row link grid with columns at x 1318 / 1537 / 1757 and rows at y≈110/160/209/259, regular weight, ~19px, grey. Across the middle sits a giant white lowercase grotesk wordmark "meadow" (x 115-1812, the d ascender top at y 450, x-height top ~535). Its lower part is hidden behind the front hill, so the word sits inside the landscape. In the grass are four 3D objects: a large frosted pink-magenta crystal (230-535, y 845-1005), a small violet amethyst point (~758-833, y 870-950), a matte peach-orange sphere (1133-1258, y 835-935) and a tall frosted lavender crystal (1520-1690, y 800-990). Footer at y≈1028: "© 2026 Meadow" at left, "Privacy  Terms  Cookies" centred at x 823-1063, and four white social glyphs (X, Instagram, GitHub, RSS) at x≈1677/1722/1768/1813. Motion: from 0 to ~1.2s the whole scene goes from heavily blurred to sharp. The heading and nav fade in and rise ~13-16px, and the footer fades in and rises ~20px. The "meadow" letters rise up from behind the hill one after another, left to right: m first, w last and still ~60px low at 1s, all settled by ~2s. Moving the cursor over the grass (2-2.5s) leaves a trail of white daisies and small pink/purple wildflowers that sprout along its path and stay. A click switches day to night, and the night scene is revealed through a soft, feathered circle that grows out from the click point (4.05-4.45s). Night has a navy sky with the Milky Way and stars, dark grey clouds, and dark blue-green grass. The peach sphere glows warm, the pink crystal throws a red glow on the grass, and a yellow-green light with drifting firefly specks follows the cursor. The heading turns light grey/white. A second click at ~(650,970) wipes back to day (6.65-7.0s), and a third click at ~(1760,750) wipes to night again (8.05-8.5s). It stays night to the end, with the cursor light moving over the grass.

s9yg0m-hanging-team-profile-cards.summary: A light (#fcfcfc) careers/team section. Top-left: a tiny tracked uppercase eyebrow "OUR STUDIO · THE PEOPLE" with a violet dot, then a two-line large sans headline, "Meet the people" in near-black and "behind the work." in soft lavender (#a497dc-ish), ~60px type. Top-right: a two-line grey paragraph and a green-dot uppercase tag "04 PEOPLE, ONE TEAM". Across the middle a thin grey wire runs from x≈247 to x≈1310 and sags in a shallow curve (ends y≈303, middle y≈327). It has four small grey round pins at x≈282/613/944/1275. From each pin a hairline string drops to a grey ring-clip at the top centre of a hanging card. The four cards (~300×415, radius ~22, light grey #f2f2f2 with a soft drop shadow) each hang at a slight rest tilt (about −2°, +1°, −1°, +1.5°) and at staggered heights: card tops ≈362, 445, 402, 440. Each front has a small "PEOPLE · STUDIO" label and "#0n" number, a rounded square 3D-character avatar render on a tinted backdrop (pink, lilac, mustard, lilac), a large name, a grey role, a hairline divider, "VIEW PROFILE" and a black circle with a white ↗ arrow. Clicking a card flips it 180° on its vertical axis, a perspective rotateY of ~0.5–0.65s. The back is a holographic card: a soft iridescent pastel gradient (cyan, pink, mint-yellow, violet) that drifts with the pointer. It holds "PROFILE / 0n", a round avatar, name and role, location, a one-line bio, "SELECTED PROJECTS" with two ruled rows, "LET'S CONNECT" plus an email, and a QR code with "SCAN ME", with a round flip-back icon at top right. Only one card shows its back at a time: opening the next card flips the open one back to its front in the same moment (Maya at 0–0.5s, Leo at ~0.8–1.45s, Noah at ~1.8–2.4s, Noah back to front ~2.8–3.45s, Leo again ~6.05–6.65s, and so on). Hovering a card tilts it in 3D toward the pointer (up to ~8–10° tilt, the card skews in perspective) and lays the same iridescent shimmer over its front (3.6–5.9s on Noah and Amina). The wire, strings, header and footer never move, and cards that are not hovered or flipping hold still. The footer has two small tracked grey captions: "THE PEOPLE MAKE THE WORK." at left and "HOVER TO SHIMMER · CLICK / TAP TO FLIP" at right.

1rj1vm-graphical-inline-icon-hero.summary: A centred hero on a flat white (#ffffff) 1648x1080 canvas. At the top, around y 237–388, sits a black outlined stadium badge [603,237,448,151]. Its stroke is about 14 px and it holds the word "Graphical" in a heavy, tightly tracked black grotesk. Below it, at y ≈ 552–841, is a three-line centred sentence in a regular grotesk of about 72 px, near-black #171716: "A tool to create visual [icon languages], / customize [icon motion], and build / interfaces with [icon ChatGPT]." Each line holds one inline pill, a full-radius light grey (#ededea) capsule about 87 px tall. The pill starts with a sticker-style icon (a colour glyph with a white die-cut border and a soft drop shadow, overlapping the pill's left end) and ends with a dark word. A small pointing-hand cursor hovers over a pill, and the hovered pill darkens to about #e2e4e1. The motion is a word-swap carousel. Every 0.45–0.6 s one pill morphs. The old icon pops out and the new icon springs in with a slight overshoot in scale and rotation. The word cross-fades letter by letter: incoming letters arrive grey and staggered, then settle to black. The pill width springs to fit the new word, and the whole line re-centres so its left and right edges move symmetrically. Line 3 cycles ChatGPT → Claude (~0.5 s) → Cursor (~1.1 s) → Grok (~1.7 s), then holds on Grok. Line 2 cycles motion → components (~2.45 s) → colors (~3.35 s) → type → spacing → icons → states → components → colors → effects → motion (~8.8 s). Line 1 swaps languages → themes (~2.9 s) → systems → languages (~4.1 s) → themes (~4.6 s). The final rest is "themes / motion / Grok" from about 9 s to 10.27 s. The badge never moves.

1u1wfj-article-share-card-modal.summary: Screen recording of an article page with a camera move. 0–0.85s: the camera is zoomed in on a light (#fafafa) app window with a rounded bottom-left corner. Behind it, an impressionist painted wallpaper shows in a strip at the left and bottom. On the left of the window is an action menu: "Share" (highlighted by a faint pill, hand cursor on it), "Ask AI", "Copy as Markdown", each with a thin line icon. On the right are large grey sans article text lines and two tilted black-and-white photo prints with white borders. After the click at ~0.85s, the view whips away with heavy motion blur (0.85–1.05s). The page becomes a soft, heavily blurred white-grey backdrop. A centred white modal (~718×792, radius ~24, soft shadow, hairline outline) scales/drifts into place and settles by ~1.5s. In the modal: a "Share article" title at top left and a close × at top right. Below that is a preview card of the article: a serif headline "Make your design system AI-ready" and a grey sans excerpt that fades out toward the bottom. The card text fades in ~1.2–1.4s, and two blank cards fan out behind it, slightly rotated, by ~1.9s. Below the card is a row of four light-grey circular share buttons (X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, mail). At the bottom is a pill URL field with a copy icon. From 2.5 to 3.65s the arrow cursor travels from the bottom-left to the copy button and becomes a hand. At ~4.25–4.4s the copy icon cross-fades (blurred) into a checkmark on a round hover tint. It holds to 6.18s.

132a6s-butterflies-thinking-animation.summary: A near-white (#fdfdfd) 1160x720 canvas with one huge black line of type, "Thinking..." in a neutral grotesque sans (Inter/SF-like, regular-medium weight, cap height ~120px), spanning x 218-934, baseline ~y405, with the g descender to ~y435. Top-right sits a small pill button "GIF" with a download-arrow icon (box ~1055,18,86,44), white fill, 1px very light grey border, fully rounded. The text and button never move. The motion is a looping swarm of small flat-illustrated butterflies (~15-35px), each with two-tone wings (upper and lower wings in different saturated colours: purple, pink, orange, yellow, teal, mint, sky blue), a white highlight dot on each wing lobe, a thin dark body and two antennae. A cycle runs ~4.3s and plays twice (0.3-3.15s and 4.7-7.6s): butterflies enter from the left of the word, flock onto the letters left to right until the glyphs are densely covered (peak ~1.0-1.7s and ~5.3-6.0s, with "Thinking" heavily covered and the dots partly), then lift off and drift up and to the right, fading and blurring as they recede (distant ones are translucent and soft), leaving the screen empty by ~3.2s and ~7.6s. Between swarms (3.2-4.65s) the frame holds plain text only; the butterflies flap (wings change silhouette frame to frame) and sit on top of the type.

1ld66j-axonometric-floor-plan-stepper.summary: A light-grey (#f3f3f3) stepper page that auto-plays through four axonometric line-drawing diagrams, all in the same template: a small letter-spaced mono eyebrow ("AXONOMETRIC PLAN · OPTIONAL MOTION" / "EXPLODED AXONOMETRIC · OPTIONAL MOTION"), a condensed serif title "Subject · Subtitle" at left x=39, a centred isometric drawing in white fills with thin dark-grey outlines and one salmon/coral (#f7e8e8 fill, ~#c8452f text) focal accent, a mono "FOCAL ZONE/ROOM/LAYER" caption with a small italic sentence, a full-width hairline divider, then a control row: five outlined square-ish buttons (Previous, Play, Pause, Next, Replay), a sans hint line "←/→ step · Space play/pause · R replay · Home/End jump", and a right-aligned mono "Step n of N". The whole block is vertically centred, so its y shifts per scene. Scenes: Fulfillment floor (0–3.85s, steps 0–3: empty floor with pink packing band, then Receiving + Storage racks fade in, then Pick zone + Packing stations, then Shipping), Corner coffee shop (3.85–8.15s, Kitchen/Restroom, Espresso bar in coral, Entrance, Seating), Mechanical keyboard (8.15–13.05s, exploded layers Keycaps/Switches/Plate/PCB/Case separate downward one by one with leader-line labels fading in at right), AI agent stack (13.05–17.37s, Interface/Agent harness/Skills/Tools/Secrets vault slabs separate). Changes are fades and short vertical slides of drawn parts; scene cuts are instant; the step counter and Previous enabled state update with each step.

1d5ivc-elemental-glow-cards.summary: A dark, nearly black stage (#070707–#080a09 with a fine film grain) holds a horizontal carousel of four tall pill-shaped cards (fully rounded ends, ~230 x 370 px), three visible at once on one baseline: left card centred x≈263, active card centred x≈720, right card centred x≈1178 (≈457 px pitch), all spanning y≈335–710. The cycle is 01 Ember (fire), 02 Solar (sun), 03 Breeze (air), 04 Bloom (heart). Each card carries a tiny monospace index at top ("01"…), a thin white line icon in the middle (campfire flame over crossed logs; sun with 8 rays; three wind lines with curls; six-petal flower with a ring centre), a bold grotesk title (~28 px) and a letter-spaced monospace caption ("FIRE · COURAGE", "SUN · VITALITY", "AIR · CLARITY", "HEART · WARMTH"). Inactive cards are black-to-deep-red (Breeze black-to-green) with a faint 1 px grey rim, grey type and no glow. The active centre card turns into a soft glossy mesh gradient (Ember magenta→orange, Solar salmon/orange/lime, Breeze mint/green/blue, Bloom violet→magenta), its type goes pure white, and it wears an element effect: painterly flames with sparks and little outline triangles rising off its top (Ember), a gold rim with a radial sunburst of fine rays and small floating rings (Solar), a halo of curved mint streak lines flowing around it like wind through a tunnel (Breeze), or a large glowing pink lotus of painted petals behind it (Bloom). The page background, a horizontal glow strip on the floor at y≈850 and a blurred mirror reflection of the cards at the bottom edge (y≈960–1080) all tint to the active element's colour. Clicking a side card slides the whole row ~457 px in ~0.35–0.4 s (e.g. 0.93–1.3 s) so that card lands in the centre; its effect then blooms in over ~0.3–0.5 s while the outgoing card's effect breaks up into drifting particles and fades as it slides to the side, and a fourth card fades in/out at the frame edge. Between clicks the active effect keeps animating in place (flames flicker, rays and rings drift, wind streaks flow, petals glow) while the cards themselves stay still.

1fut80-minimal-tooltip-thinking-mode.summary: A plain light canvas (#fdfdfd) built like an AI chat transcript. A near-black pill message bubble (#101010, fully rounded, about 383x85 px) sits top-right at x 607–990, y 108–193 and reads "Get us live in Sweden." in white sans (~28 px). It blurs and fades in between 0.3 s and 0.7 s. Under it, a left-aligned agent log starts at x 104 (icons) and x 149 (text), top row at y 283. From about 1.5 s a spinner and a shimmering grey "Start thinking…" header with a running seconds counter appear. Below them, grey reasoning text (~26 px, 44 px line height) streams in word by word with a blur fade. The text scrolls upward behind a top fade mask: two paragraphs, then the numbered list "1. Read Swedish order history … 5. Write the launch report", then "Orders first. They set the baseline for everything else." At about 6 s the whole thinking block blurs away and the header rolls from "Start thinking…" to "Working", led by a chevron. A thin grey vertical timeline at x 115 then grows down the left as steps arrive in 63 px rows, each with a spinner that turns into a grey dot when it finishes. The steps are: "Done thinking"; "Reading → Read 🛍 Shopify Swedish orders" with a bordered, rounded two-row subtask card (spinners become black check discs); "Start searching N sources → Searched 46 sources" with grey chips (acedesign.io, LinkedIn – Ace Design Io…, X – Ace Design Io News, AI Search, 20+ more); "Delegating to Brand Researcher" with a second subtask card; "Preparing the report" with a file-preview card labelled "sweden-insight PDF" and a blue cursor. That card collapses to "Report is ready 📄 Sweden Insight", and "Finished working" with a blue check disc blurs in at about 28.5 s. The bubble never moves. All motion is appearance in place: blur and fade, spinner rotation, counter ticks, and rows pushing content down.

1humge-minimal-portfolio-refresh.summary: A minimal light portfolio (#fefefe page, near-black type) recorded as a 30s screen walk-through. A dark #282828 pill nav floats top-centre at [634,22,419,58] (radius ~8, large soft grey shadow spreading ~60px below it) with "Home", "About me", "Sketches" in grey 16px Inter-like type, the active one white, and a lighter grey (#707070) "Contact me" button inset at its right; it stays fixed while the page scrolls under it, and the top ~12px of the frame carries a faint grey fade. Home page: a 91px grayscale portrait square with rounded corners centred at y176, then a two-line centred intro in mixed grey/black ("Senior Product Designer Helin Kıl" / "Currently at Refine Studio") which fades in around 0.3–0.9s; below, a two-column project grid (columns x245 and x862, 579px wide, ~478px row pitch) of label + very light grey card: Bookmarks Component (three postage stamps over a white envelope with a 4-icon row), Sketchbook Social (iPhone with an egg-on-plate camera screen), Axis Crypto and Runway Dashboard (browser screenshots), Petra AI and Count Me Social (phones). The grid appears around 1–1.7s; at 2.2→2.7 the stamps re-settle and the phone screen changes. The page scrolls up 237px at 4.45–4.8s and another ~448px at 5.85–6.4s; at ~6.6s "About me" is clicked and the page swaps to About: the same intro lines, an italic serif "Nice to meet you!", two centred body paragraphs, and a photographic still-life of a grey metal shelf unit with a red wall clock (live "11:14 AM" with a Turkish flag), red photo frame, pink glowing lamp, three design books, plant, turntable, speaker and flip clock. That page scrolls ~253px at 9.3–9.55s, the recording zooms in ~1.43x at 12.25–12.5s, the books fan apart on hover around 15.5s, it zooms back out at 18.4–18.75s and scrolls through an experience list of logo rows and testimonials (19.3–22s); at ~22.5–23s "Sketches" is clicked and a playful Sketches page appears: italic serif "Welcome to my design sketches!", body copy, a red italic hint "Feel free to drag and explore the designs", on a faint square grid with scattered draggable UI shots (iPhone dock, Photos/Camera app icons, an empty-state card, a dark calendar invite card, a permission card, a sticker-stuffed envelope).

x3v0ch-food-joints-scroll-carousel.summary: A minimal, centred single-page showcase on a white (#ffffff) surface. Top-left a pale grey pill button "Dark" (≈30,27,68x40, radius full, 14px grey type); bottom centre a muted grey hint "Scroll to browse · click a restaurant" at y≈1038. The middle band (y≈335–730) is a horizontal carousel of isometric low-poly 3D storefront renders (Starbucks, KFC, Domino's, Taco Bell, McDonald's, Burger King, Subway, Pizza Hut…), one per column on a ≈431px pitch; each column stacks a small grey "Since YYYY" line at y≈343, a ≈310x260 render (y≈370–630), a dark 16px name at y≈694 and a lighter grey category at y≈718. The column nearest the centre is fully opaque with near-black name; neighbours are faded (lighter text, washed-out render) and the outermost columns fade into white at the screen edges. Motion: 0–1.9s rest with KFC centred (x≈876); 1.95–2.35s the strip glides left ≈422px (KFC to x≈454), then continues to ≈2.5s so Taco Bell is centred (x≈948) and McDonald's sits at x≈1379; ≈3.6–4.3s the user clicks McDonald's: the carousel fades out and a detail view fades in with the McDonald's render enlarged and centred (≈655–1265 x 130–595), a 36px near-black title "McDonald's" at y≈740, grey "Burgers", a bold 18px quote line, a two-line grey description (centred, max ≈550px) and a small grey "Founded 1940 …" line, "Drag to rotate" hint at the bottom and a "Back" pill top-right (≈1818,27,72x40). From ≈5.5–7.5s the model is dragged and orbits about its vertical axis (rear view at ≈6.2s), then returns to front. ≈8.65–9.05s the "Dark" pill is clicked: the whole page cross-fades through mid grey (#5f5f5f at 8.85s) to near-black #0d0d0f, the pill reads "Light", type turns white/grey, and the 3D scene is relit as night—the golden arches glow with a soft bloom, windows glow warm, a lamp post casts a warm pool on the lot. The model is rotated again ≈9.5–11.5s. At ≈12.5s "Back" is clicked and the dark-mode carousel returns (≈13.2s) with McDonald's/Burger King centred, then scrolls left to Subway and Pizza Hut by 14.9s.

pw5p26-next-js-site-redesign.summary: A Next.js marketing homepage shown inside a 1482x988 black browser-like panel (46,46) with a 1px #202020 rounded border on a pure #000 canvas. A fixed 77px top nav holds the white triangle logo, a grey slash, the 'NEXT.js' wordmark, six grey links (Docs, Learn, Showcase, Blog, Templates ↗, Deploy ↗) and on the right a dark 'Search… ⌘K' field, an outlined 'Ask AI' button and a GitHub icon. The hero is centred: a giant outlined 'NEXT' wordmark (~965x230, 2px blue #255acd strokes, no fill) whose strokes fade to near-black navy toward the bottom, overlapped by a tight, bold white two-line headline 'The React Framework / for the Web' (~70px), a grey subline with bold white phrases, and a pill-shaped monospace 'npx create-next-app@latest' chip with a copy icon. The clip is a vertical page scroll in bursts, the nav staying fixed: 0.8–1.35s the hero scrolls up ~660px (a 1px nav bottom divider and a right-edge scrollbar thumb appear); by 3.05s 'Everything you need to build great products on the web' sits under the nav (scroll ~917) above three 455px feature cards with line-art illustrations (dotted mountains with ORIGINAL/1440PX/375PX frames, a grid with a browser mock, a 6-node tree); 4.65–5.35s it scrolls ~816px into a 3x3 text feature grid ending in a solid #0a66ff 'Next.js 16 →' card; 6.05–6.65s ~730px to 'Built on a foundation of fast, production-grade tooling' with React/Turbopack/Speedy Web Compiler cards; 7.55–8.05s ~484px more, revealing 'The framework of choice when it matters' with greyscale site screenshots; later bursts (8.65–9.35, 9.9–10.55, 11.3–11.85) move through the showcase, Sonos/Notion testimonial quotes and 'Get started in seconds' templates. Type is a tight geometric grotesk, white headlines, #a8a8a8 body; the mouse cursor stays parked in the frame.

1t0kma-casting-strength-radio-group.summary: A single white settings card sits centred-left on a flat #f9f9f9 page (card ~[405,323,617,433], ~40px corner radius, 1px light-grey hairline border, a very soft diffuse shadow below). Inside, a small grey label "Casting strength" heads a vertical radio group of three rows spaced 112px apart: Whisper / "A quiet spell, barely felt", Chant / "Steady power, held for a while", Invocation / "Everything, all at once". Each row has a 40px radio on the left (x≈449–489) and a two-line text block at x=515: a ~26px medium title over a ~22px grey description. Unselected radios are thin 2px light-grey rings; the selected radio is a thick blue ring (vertical gradient, deeper #216de2 at top to brighter #1889e3 at bottom) with a ~14px white centre, and its title turns near-black. Hovering a row fills it with a light grey rounded rectangle (#f2f2f2, ~572x107, ~18px radius) and darkens its title. Motion: a hand cursor clicks rows in turn; on each click the old blue dot disintegrates into small square blue pixels (~3-4px) that stream diagonally, like a spell, across the text to the newly clicked radio, where they reassemble into the blue dot. Each transfer takes ~0.3s (first one: Whisper dot breaks up 1.00–1.12s, Chant dot complete by ~1.27s). The selection cycles Whisper→Chant (~1.0s)→Invocation (~2.4s)→Whisper (~3.7s)→Chant (~5.0s)→Invocation (~6.2s)→Whisper (~7.3s)→Invocation (~8.6s)→Whisper (~10.0s); the card itself never moves or resizes.

k6mm9q-mobbin-homepage-redesign.summary: A scroll-through of a redesigned Mobbin homepage on an off-white (#fdfdfd) page, 1728x1080. A full-width top bar holds the black Mobbin 'M' logo at x≈200, the nav links MCP / Customers / Pricing in dark medium sans, and on the right a YouTube glyph, an X glyph, a thin vertical divider and 'Log in' that ends at x≈1526. The hero is centred: a three-line, very bold, tightly tracked near-black headline 'Where teams / and agents find / designs that work' (cap height ≈70px, lines ≈97px apart), a two-line grey subtitle, then a black pill 'Join for free' beside a light-grey pill 'See plans →'. A large rounded light-grey frame holding a white Mobbin app preview peeks in at the bottom from y≈930. Motion: from 0 to ≈1.1s the headline comes into focus from a heavy blur, with a top-to-bottom fade (line 1 darkest, line 3 lightest) that resolves to solid black. Centred on it is one square rounded card (radius ~40px) split by a hard vertical seam into a light half (#e7e7e7) and a dark half (#1e1e1e): the same chat-app mock is drawn in both themes and the seam reveals one or the other. Card content, top to bottom: a white 'Light' pill top-left and a grey 'Dark' pill top-right; a browser-window card with three dots and a blue-to-orange gradient glow along its top-left rim, holding a message card ('C' avatar, grey skeleton lines, two small face photos) and a row of three round buttons (the middle one a blue sparkle button); to its right a list in monospace (B Business 24 chats, W Work 32 chats, C Clients 48 chats highlighted, D Design 64 chats, D Dev 80 chats); faint ghost panels clipped at both card edges; a pill toggle on thin connector lines; and a bottom card split into 'Create link / https://ui8.net' (smiley icon) and 'Meeting / 2 joined' (blue calendar icon). A white 56px circular handle with ‹ › chevrons, ringed by a faint concentric circle, rides the seam at the card's vertical centre. A screen-recording mouse cursor drives it. Motion: the card holds at 552px wide (0–1.6s), scales down about its centre to ~392px (1.6–1.95s), then scales up to 716px (2.3–2.65s). From ~3.4s the cursor drags the seam left and right many times (x≈548 → 451 → 237 → 471 → 823 → 548…). The half being newly revealed near the seam dissolves in: blurred, with tiny particles (blue + and × marks on the light side, white star specks on the dark side), then sharpens. Around 10.5–10.75s the card scales down again and grows back by ~11.55s. The background stays still throughout.

19aisf-swiftui-magnetic-metal-effect.summary: Overhead handheld-camera shot of the bottom half of a black iPhone lying on a cream travertine/marble tabletop, with a big out-of-focus green plant leaf in the left foreground, the table's curved edge and brown floor along the bottom, and the phone's titanium-grey bezel and rounded bottom corners centred (phone body roughly x 262–725, y 0–468). On the near-black screen, about 50 px above the bottom bezel, sit two controls on one row: a pill email field (~283×62, fully rounded ends) in translucent smoky grey with a thin light rim and a brighter specular cap on its right end, holding the placeholder "Your email" in light grey sans-serif (~16 px), left-aligned; and to its right a 56 px circular arrow button: dark disc, bright white metallic ring about 3 px thick, and a white "→" in the centre. The effect: a hand brings a matte black magnet puck (~165 px) in from the lower right toward the phone's right edge. As it gets close, the button's metal ring bulges toward it (from a circle into an egg/teardrop that stretches ~10 px toward the magnet) and a bluish-white specular glow gathers on the side facing the magnet. When the magnet is pulled away it relaxes back to a perfect circle. The cycle repeats several times: approach 0.1–1.3 s, peak bend ~1.55–1.75 s, withdrawal 1.9–2.55 s, no magnet 2.6–3.8 s with a round ring, then approaches again around 4–5 s, 5.75–6.6 s, 6.9–7.75 s, 7.9–8.45 s, 8.85–10.6 s and 10.95–12.1 s. The camera drifts by a few px throughout. Nothing else in the UI moves.

k8d80k-flight-status-card-microinteracti.summary: A single white flight-status card (962x311, ~60px corner radius, no visible shadow) sits centred on a flat cool-grey #c7c8cf field. Three columns: left 'JFK' (large dark grey bold sans) over 'New York' (light slate grey) over a pale lavender pill with a grey outline clock icon and '03:20 PM'; right column mirrors it right-aligned with 'LAX', 'Los Angeles', '09:40 PM'; centre column stacks 'ON TIME' in orange-red monospace caps, a route line (two short light-grey rounded tracks either side of a solid orange-red plane icon pointing right, with small orange speed dashes behind its tail), and '6h 10m' in dark grey. Motion: the whole view is a camera zoom on the centre column. Rest until ~1.0s, then the card scales up about the centre (~719,550) with horizontal motion blur, ~2.3x by 1.6s and ~3.9x by ~2.3s, where only 'ON TIME', the route and '6h 10m' fill a white frame. It holds zoomed 2.4–5.4s, then zooms back out (5.6–6.95s, ~2x at 6.3s) to the original rest card, which holds to 8s. Throughout, a short orange segment keeps sliding left-to-right along the left grey track and wraps back to its start (a progress marquee), the speed dashes behind the plane flicker and shift, and the plane nudges slightly. Everything else stays still.

1g1yor-minimal-kanban-board-component.summary: A light, minimal Kanban board on an off-white #f9f9f9 page, 1080x1080. Top left: the title "Billing v2" (about 20px, near-black, medium weight) with a muted grey "12 cards" beside it. Top right: a pill segmented control "Status | Swimlanes" (about 143x34, light grey track). The active segment is a white pill with warm orange-brown text. Below are four equal columns, each about 253px wide with 12px gutters, starting at x 16/281/546/811 and running from y 166 to 1016. Each column is a very light grey rounded panel (radius about 16, soft edge). The headers above them read "Backlog 4", "In progress 3/3", "In review 2/2" and "Done 3", each with a grey count and a thin "+" at the right. Cards are white, 235px wide, radius about 10, with a hairline grey border and a faint shadow. Each card has a monospaced grey ID (e.g. "BIL-142"), a coloured-dot tag at top right (orange Billing, purple Design, blue API, olive Lifecycle), a 14px dark title on one or two lines, a grey meta row (calendar date, checklist fraction, "N pt") and a 22px round photo avatar at bottom right. Each column ends with a grey "+ Add card". Motion is a cursor demo in three acts. (1) 0–0.4s: the cursor hovers BIL-142 at the top of Backlog and the card's border darkens. From 0.5s it is picked up: it lifts, tilts about 3–4°, and gets a warm peach border and shadow. The remaining Backlog cards slide up 124px. While it is over In progress (about 0.9s), that column gets an orange outline and beige tint, its count turns amber "4/3" with an "Over limit" pill, and a dashed placeholder opens. It then moves to In review, where a dashed slot opens under BIL-124 (1.6s). It drops at about 1.85s and settles flat. In review now reads amber "3/2 Over limit" and its panel stays beige; Backlog reads 3. (2) 4.0–5.2s: BIL-128 is dragged the same way from the top of In progress to the top of Done. In progress closes up 107px and reads "2/3"; the Done cards shift down 106px and Done reads "4". (3) About 6.0–6.5s: the cursor moves to the toggle and clicks "Swimlanes" (about 6.5s); the white pill slides to Swimlanes. From 6.6 to 7.2s the board regroups into four assignee lanes ("Emma Collins 4", "Marcus Johnson 3", "Chloe Nguyen 2", "Daniel Kim 3"), each with an avatar header and one rounded cell per column. Cards glide into their lane cells and empty cells stay as blank grey panels. The board then holds to 8.8s.

1ipk9s-flyingpress-bento-feature-grid.summary:
A light, centred feature section on a near-white #f2f2f4 page. At top centre is a small white pill eyebrow, "Why FlyingPress" (y≈67–97). Below it is a large near-black headline, "Real-time WordPress optimization" (≈48px, tight tracking, y≈112–160), and a one-line grey subtitle (y≈184). Under these sits a 3×2 bento grid of white cards, each 360×382 with ≈20px radius and 15px gutters (columns x=45/420/795, rows y=234/631). The upper part of each card is an illustration on a soft peach-to-orange wash, some with a faint dotted texture. Each card ends with a 20px dark title and two lines of 14px grey body text at the bottom left. The whole thing runs on a 6 s loop with 2 s beats:
(1) "Easy to Use": a FlyingPress plugin card. It shows "Active" with an orange "✓ Optimized" button and three green-checked chips until ≈2.3s. It then flips to "Inactive" / "Optimize my site" with empty-circle chips. A cursor glides onto the button at ≈3.9s and clicks it at ≈4.4s; the label blurs, and by ≈5s it is back to Active.
(2) "Fewer Settings": three toggle pills (Page Caching, Image Optimization, Critical CSS). They switch off and on, collapse into a single stacked "All optimizations" pill at ≈2.5–4.3s, then fan back out with all three on.
(3) "Core Web Vitals": three metric pills (CLS, LCP, INP) with ring gauges and Good/Poor/Needs-work badges. The middle pill is enlarged. Every ≈2s (at 0.4, 2.45, 4.4, 6.4) the list scrolls up one pill, and the ring values count and recolour.
(4) "All in One": a large white arch cut into the orange wash. Faint app-icon tiles sit behind it and fade in and out, with a glossy orange FlyingPress app icon at the bottom of the funnel.
(5) "Great Support": an orange user avatar centred in concentric peach rings, with three small white icon bubbles (?, headset, cursor) orbiting it clockwise.
(6) "Compatibility": a glossy FlyingPress icon in the middle row between a cloud tile and a "+" tile. The top row of logo tiles (W, Kinsta, grid logo) slides left and the bottom row (Elementor, cloud, +) slides right as a continuous marquee.
The header and the card frames never move.

1odjuy-google-calendar-empty-state.summary: A single centred empty state sits on an off-white (#fafafa) canvas with a 1px grey top edge. The background has faint horizontal dotted rules about 24px apart that fade out radially from the centre, so they only show in a soft oval around the content. The centre column holds three things. First, a cluster of three rounded-square white tiles (about 62px, radius about 14px, soft drop shadow, each tilted a little differently): a Google "G" on the left, a grey plug-and-socket glyph in the middle that sits higher, and a dark-green squiggle on the right. Below that is a semibold dark green-grey title, "Connect your Google account", then a two-line grey body paragraph, then a green pill button reading "Connect Google" with an arrow cursor resting on its right end. All of it is centred on x≈547. The motion tells one story and then loops. At about 1.5s the button label is replaced by a small white tick spinner. Between 2.65s and 2.8s the button fades out and the whole stack slides down about 49px to recentre. The middle tile's plug becomes a dashed ring, the title becomes "Syncing your calendar" and the body becomes one line, "Your meetings will appear here once it's done". From about 3s to 7.8s a dark grey pie wedge fills clockwise inside the dashed ring. At about 7.8s it turns into a solid green circle with a white check, and the two side tiles fade to about half strength. From 8.0s to 8.5s the text crossfades to "Calendar synced" / "Your meetings are ready". From about 9.3s the empty state fades away. Between 9.5s and 10.2s a full-width meeting list fades in row by row from the top: a pale-green "Coming up 4" header band, four upcoming rows, a grey "Earlier 208" band, then dated rows (date, time, small app logo, title, avatar stack on the right). The cursor becomes a hand over the highlighted "Ashford pilot checkpoint" row. At 11.9–12.05s the list crossfades straight back to the original "Connect Google" empty state.

1xfcpx-cute-button-figma-tutorial.summary: A single-artboard Figma-style build-up on a flat cool-gray canvas (#ecedf2), 576x720, with a dark pill caption centred at the bottom (y≈641-675) naming each step. 0.4-1.1s: a 1px sky-blue outline draws itself clockwise from the top-left of a 352x352 squircle (radius ≈128 px at frame scale, 'Rectangle 132 × 132 · Radius 48') centred at x=288, y≈183-535. ~1.3s it fills cool gray (#cfd4df) and the outline vanishes. ~1.5-2.5s an inner top light and vertical gradient turn it into a soft white-to-gray pillow ('Gradient · Inner light 14 · White 80%'); ~4.5s a top sheen ('Sheen · White 62% to 0 · Blur 4'); ~5.3s a soft stacked drop shadow under it ('Shadow · Y 5, 14, 24 · Blur 7, 18, 32'). ~6.0-7.5s a heart outline draws in the centre, fills white and gets a gray halo ring ('Icon · Ring 16'). ~8.2-8.55s the button is pressed and recolours pink with a deep-pink heart and lighter pink halo ('Press · Colour from the icon · 180 ms'). ~9.4-10.5s 'Repeat × 4': the pink button shrinks and moves to the top-left as three white copies slide out, settling into a 2x2 grid of ~186 px buttons (cols x 82/307, rows y 153/378). ~10.8-11.6s moon, drop and leaf outlines draw and fill white, then ~12-13.1s the tiles recolour one by one: purple moon, blue drop, green leaf. The caption fades out around 13s and the final grid holds to 15.98s.

e1gket-design-stack-data-table.summary: A single light-grey rounded card (#ececec, ~40px radius, 82..1633 x 159..925) is centred on a near-white #f7f7f7 page. Its top strip has a blue rounded-square app icon, the title "Design Stack" in dark medium sans (~30px), and undo/redo arrows at the right, pale grey when disabled. Inset in the card sits a white table (~36px radius, faint shadow, hairline #e5e5e5 grid). The table has a checkbox column, then Tool, Category, Website and Renews headers, each with a small grey glyph and mid-grey label. There are five 95px rows: Figma, Linear, Vercel, Framer and Loom, each with its brand logo, a tinted category pill (purple Design, blue Issue tracking, grey Hosting, pink Website, green Video), an underlined domain link and a renewal date. The footer reads "+ Add row" on the left and "Double-click a cell to edit" on the right in mid grey. The clip is a recorded cursor session in which every change is an instant state swap, not a slide. At 1.0s Linear is checked: its box turns black with a white tick, the row tints pale blue, the header box shows a black minus, and the footer becomes "1 selected · Delete (red, trash icon) · Clear". At 2.0s the rows re-sort by Tool (blue up arrow), and at 3.1s by Category (the arrow moves to Category). Then come blue cell outlines on B2 (4.1s) and B4 (4.95s), with the cell reference shown at bottom right. At 5.9s an opaque white dropdown with a soft shadow opens, listing Design / Issue tracking / Hosting / Website / Video, with the current value in blue. At 7.05s Hosting is picked: Loom's pill becomes Hosting, Loom re-sorts to row 3, and undo darkens. Next, Loom's Website cell is edited: "https://loom.com" in a double blue ring at 9.3s, cleared by 9.8s. Delete at ~11.55s removes Linear, and the card shrinks by one row (top +47, bottom −47) in ~0.2s. Add row at ~12.35s appends an empty row with a caret in its Tool cell and the card grows back. Undo at ~14.1s removes that row, shrinking the card again, and redo turns dark.

1v71w2-connectivity-cloud-network-map.summary: A square 1080x1080 light canvas (#fbfbfb) filled edge to edge with a loose, uneven lattice of thin pale-grey outline circles (about 2 px, ~#ececec, no fill, diameters roughly 170 to 240 px). Most circles are empty. Some hold one centred brand icon about 60 to 80 px wide: a dark rounded-square 'lines' app icon, a black cube, a black hexagon cluster, the GitLab fox, a black 'W' wordmark, and further along an orange asterisk, a grey/black door rectangle, a navy outline ghost, a blue-violet terminal cloud, a black ⌘ key tile, the VS Code logo, a purple Terraform mark, a green check, a black Copilot face, a GitHub mark, a red 'M' and a purple bolt. Near the centre sits the hub: a larger solid white disc, about 262 px across, centred near (535,347). It has a soft diffuse drop shadow below and a faint grey rim, and holds the orange/amber Cloudflare cloud. Two to five very faint thin grey straight lines (spokes) radiate from just outside the hub's rim toward nearby icon circles and stop short of them. The motion never stops from about 0.2 s to the end. The whole field of circles streams downward past the hub at roughly 400 to 480 px/s with a slight sideways drift. Each circle moves at a slightly different speed, so the lattice loosens and re-packs. New icon circles enter from the top edge and leave at the bottom, and spokes re-attach to whichever icons are currently nearest. The hub stays put, wandering by no more than about 20 px.

1l9xq0-ascii-shark-ai-chat.summary: A light, near-white chat landing page (#fafafa) covered by a faint ruled grid of character cells (about 10 px wide by 14.6 px tall), with a 1 px grey hairline along the top and an 11 px warm-grey band (#dddbd6) across the bottom. Everything is centred on one column. At the top sits a small frosted 'History' pill [522,15,130,46] with a clock-with-arrow icon, grey label and a down chevron, plus a soft drop shadow. In the middle a large, light, thin-weight sans heading reads "what’s on your mind?" (about 60 px, near-black, x 322–852, baseline near y 490). Just below it is a wide frosted-glass prompt bar [205,524,765,110] with a radius of about 12, a 1 px light border and a translucent grey fill. It holds the placeholder "Ask haj anything...", a + icon and a mic icon at the bottom left, the monospace hint "↵ send · ⇧↵ newline" at the bottom right, and a 38 px grey square send button with a ↗ arrow. A big blurred grey haze (#e1e2de at its centre) spreads behind the heading and bar. Behind all of it, several sharks drawn as ASCII text art swim through the frame for the whole 24.5 s. Some are brown-and-cream leopard sharks and some are blue-grey hammerheads. Each shark is built from axis-aligned grid tiles: a grey-to-black square with a light monospace glyph (S % X 8 @ t : #), plus a few tinted tiles (violet, green, orange). Faint dotted fins and 'o' bubbles trail them. The tiles snap to the grid as a shark moves, so shapes re-raster cell by cell instead of rotating. A shark that passes behind the prompt bar turns into a soft blurred smudge (backdrop blur), and inside the haze it fades lighter. Sparse small dark '-' dashes sit in grid cells, clustered left of the bar and scattered elsewhere, and they flicker and drift as the sharks pass. The UI (pill, heading, bar, button) never moves. From 0 to about 9 s, three or four sharks circle the centre. From about 9.5 to 14 s they leave toward the top-right and bottom-left corners and the centre is empty. From about 14 s, hammerheads come back in from the right and cross over the heading and bar until the end.

sl1t4t-brain-effort-slider.summary: A single dark card (x353–964, y173–532, ~20px radius, #191919 fill, faint 1–2px lighter border, soft black drop shadow) centred on a #111111 page. Inside, top row: grey "Effort" with a white value word beside it ("Low" → "Medium" → "High" → "Extra" → "Max" → "Galaxy"), and a thin outlined circled "?" icon at the top right. Below that, grey "Faster" on the left and "Smarter" on the right. Below them is a rounded track (x386–932, y382–437, ~12px radius, #262626) with six stops at x≈416, 513, 610, 707, 804, 901. Stop 2 (x513) is a short vertical pill tick that marks the recommended level; the other stops are small grey dots. A grey "Recommended" label sits under the track at the left. The knob is a pink cartoon brain (#f387bb fill, thick maroon outline) that steps right one stop about every 0.5s: Low (0–0.35s), Medium (~0.4s), High (~0.9s), Extra (~1.4s), Max (~1.9s). Each step glides about 97px in roughly 0.2s and leaves a fill behind it that grows from transparent mauve at the left to violet at the knob. Each value word changes with a blurred vertical roll: the old word drifts up and blurs out while the new one rises from below and sharpens. At about 2.4–2.65s the knob jumps to the end and becomes "Galaxy". The value word turns light sky blue. The brain turns lavender-to-pink with a dark indigo outline and pixel sparkles, and grows to about 80px. A white bloom flashes around it. Dotted rays of small square pixels (teal, grey, lavender) burst outward past the card's right edge.
