bwl3yk-paper-fold-portfolio-page.summary: A single-column personal portfolio drawn as one sheet of off-white paper (#fcfcfc). The sheet sits in a light grey surround (#f2f2f2) and has a scalloped postage-stamp edge on all four sides, inset about 25px from the frame. On the sheet, left column: a small scalloped stamp sticker (about 157px) with a crayon drawing of a red house, blue scribbles, green grass, "4:00", "NYC", "Jm.SV" and ":)". The text column starts at x≈524 and holds, top to bottom: the handwritten all-caps name "JAMES CLEMENTS"; a three-line sans-serif bio (~29px, near-black) with underlined links "Vercel" and "Old Friends"; a grey handwritten label "WRITING"; and one row with "SKILLS ARE SOFTWARE" (black handwritten, light grey underline) on the left and a grey "OCT 5" on the right at x≈1156. The cursor grabs edges and corners of the sheet and peels them back like real paper. The folded flap shows a white underside with a soft grey gradient shadow along the crease. Its scalloped edge is drawn as three stacked offset copies (blue, green, red), which reads as a misregistered print. Under the sheet is a second page: a 3×2 grid of ~300px scalloped light-grey tiles, each with a grey "?" except the top-left tile, which holds the same stamp drawing at about twice the size. Sequence: 0–0.25s a big bottom-right corner fold (crease from about (490,25) to (1590,1000)) springs back. 0.5–3.1s the top edge folds down as a nearly horizontal band (crease y≈290–490 at 1s), then becomes a diagonal top-right peel. 3.3–4.3s a top-right corner peel holds (flap tip ≈(900,900)) and then shrinks toward the top-right. 4.7–4.85s the page snaps flat (a thin wave along the top at 5s). Rest 4.9–5.85s. 5.9–6.35s the top edge rolls down to a band at y≈240–380, and 6.8–7.1s it rolls back up. Rest 7.15–8.35s. 8.4–9.05s a bottom-right corner peel sweeps the sheet off to the left and reveals the tile grid (at 9.0–9.7s only a left sliver of the sheet remains). 10.15–10.65s the sheet returns with a top-edge fold and settles flat by ~10.7s.

1kaigq-corporate-id-access-platform.summary: A dark product section (page #171719, with faint vertical page-frame rules near x=147 and x=1244) laid out on one centred column. At the top is a two-line headline in a geometric sans: "Your corporate ID," in near-white at x≈507 and y≈112–145, then "wherever you go." in mid grey, indented right to start at x≈660 (y≈148–180). Below it is a tab row centred at x≈697, y≈255: "Corporate ID" is white with a 2 px white bar above it (x 572–643, y≈234), and "Multifamily" and "Hospitality" are grey. Under the tabs is a wide, slightly lighter panel (#222227, x 169–1222, y 277–796, small radius). It holds a staggered grid of dim, dark ID cards (radius ≈12) in five columns: partly clipped strips at both edges, two full columns at x 272–532 and 860–1118 (rows y≈347–519 and 554–726), and a centre column at x 566–826 with a card pitch of 207 px. Each dim card carries a faint swap logo top-left, faint NFC arcs top-right, and a line of monospaced scrambled characters bottom-left that re-randomises every few frames. The centre card (y 451–623) is the hero. It is a lighter grey frosted-glass ID card with a top-lit gradient and a thin white outer ring offset about 3 px outside its own edge. It shows a crisp white swap logo, white NFC arcs, a pale line drawing of a classical building (3 window rows by 4 bays, arched ground floor) with ghosted angled panels at both sides, a small grey department label and a white name. Below the panel is a four-column feature row (x 169, 439, 709, 980; icons at y≈842, text from y≈876). Each column has a bold white lead-in followed by grey body copy. Column 1 has a small static spinner glyph at its top right (x≈391). Motion is a loop of about 2.9 s per card. The page, headline, tabs, side columns and feature row never move. Only the side cards' mono text keeps scrambling. At about 3.25 s (and 6.2, 9.05, 12.0, 14.9, 17.8) the hero card loses its ring, illustration and brightness and turns back into a dark card, and its name scrambles. Over about 3.3–3.75 s the whole centre column slides up 207 px. At about 3.75 s (also 0.85, 6.65, 9.55, 15.4) the card now in the centre brightens to glass and grows about 3 px each side. Its white ring draws itself from the top edge outward around the perimeter (done by about 4.3 s). The building line art fades in, and the name decodes left to right from mono glyphs into sans text by about 4.7 s. The names cycle Maximilian Thompson (Finance), Emma Williams (Product), Benjamin Scott (Sales), Zoe Mitchell (People), and more after that.

16430q-drag-shift-file-converter.summary: A screen-recorded macOS concept on the stock orange-red-yellow-violet Sonoma-style gradient wallpaper. It opens on a silver MacBook Pro mockup with a notch, on white. The camera pushes into the screen (0–1.8s) while a file icon, "Page 001.pdf", is dragged. Holding shift during the drag opens a radial menu centred on the cursor. The menu is a translucent frosted warm-glass disc with a thin golden rim. Inside the rim sit cream-to-peach petal segments with dark bold caps labels, around a hollow centre ring holding a frosted pill that shows the file size and then the hovered target. The first menu has 4 segments (DOCX top, JPG right, PNG bottom, TXT left). The hovered segment fills with a saturated red-orange gradient and its label turns white. Dropping on JPG creates "Page 001.jpg". Dragging that file opens an 8-segment image-format ring (PNG, WEBP, HEIC, TIFF, AVIF, BMP, PDF, DOCX). It then switches to a 7-segment action ring with line icons (COMPRESS, METADATA, EDIT, ANNOTATE, ADD BG, CROP, REDACT; centre "1.2 MB"). Choosing CROP zooms into a "Crop Image" sheet: a warm-gradient rounded window with the document page, a red crop frame with square corner handles, a grey dimmed outside area, an aspect-ratio segmented control (Free active in red), W/H fields, and Reset and Apply. The crop frame is dragged down about 46px between 8.05 and 8.55s. Apply produces "Page 001 Cropped.jpg". It is dragged again through the format ring and the action ring (CROP, then ADD BG highlighted). That opens an "Add BG" sheet with a gradient preview, swatch rows, Padding/Corners/Shadow sliders and Save with Background. Padding is dragged from 160 to 609 px while the camera drifts. The clip ends on the desktop with four files in a row: Page 001.pdf, Page 001.jpg, Page 001 Cropped.jpg, and "Page 001 Cropped With Ba...ound.png". Type is SF Pro throughout. Filename labels are white with a shadow, or white on blue #2a5fd6 selection pills while dragged.

104rht-menubar-ac-control.summary: A portrait 824x1080 crop of a macOS desktop. A mountain-slope photo wallpaper fills the frame under a pale sky, and a translucent light menu bar runs along the top. From left to right the menu bar holds a purple rounded pill with a screen-and-person icon, a small dot, an AC-unit glyph reading "16°", volume, battery, control centre with a purple dot, and "Mon 12". At 0.15s the AC item is highlighted with a grey pill and the cursor clicks it. Between 0.35s and 0.5s a dark navy popover (about [82,77,679,948], radius about 40, with a small caret notch under the AC item) fades in and grows slightly from about 97% scale. The popover has a vertical gradient from deep blue at the top to near-black at the bottom. Its contents, top to bottom: a row reading "Room 25°C" with a thermometer icon and a green status dot; a round blue glowing power button at the top right; a glossy white wall-AC unit showing "16 •" in blue; a fan of thin blue curved airflow lines with drifting white dashes and a row of 10 slanted ticks; a large light-grey "16" with a blue "°C"; an "Eco Mode" pill with a leaf icon and a toggle; a black inset slider track flanked by round − and + buttons, labelled "16°" and "30°"; and four rounded tile cards: Mode/Cool, Fan speed/Low, Sleep/Off, Airflow/L1. Type is SF-like sans, light on dark. Motion sequence: the slider is dragged from 16 to 30 (about 1.4–2.5s). The track fills with a blue-to-orange gradient, the big number rolls with a vertical blur, and the AC readout turns orange "30". The panel then washes to a warm brown-red (about 2.6–4.4s) while the airflow lines turn orange and the menu bar reads "30°". Next the thumb is dragged back to 16 (about 3.9–4.7s) and the panel returns to blue. Eco Mode is switched on (green leaf, blue toggle, about 6.3–8.3s) and then off. The Airflow tile is clicked (about 9.3s): it gets a blue outline and opens a dark rounded list (Swing, L1 ✓ highlighted, L2–L5, Off). Swing is chosen and the list fades out (about 10.9–11.3s); the tile then reads "Swing" and the room reading changes to "24°C". Throughout, the airflow dashes stream continuously, the fan icon spins and the status dot pulses between green and blue.

1wgoe2-ui-skeleton-loading-effect.summary: A near-white (#fcfcfc) canvas runs four short acts, each one a 'skeleton build' that resolves into a finished mobile UI card. In Act 1 (0–2.2s), three cards sit side by side on one 176px top line: Heart rate [80,176,436,453], Token spend [572,176,420,728] and the Deep Current music player [1048,176,472,553]. Each starts as a grey dotted wireframe on a dot grid. The wireframe has dotted rounded outlines, small square corner handles, monospace dimension labels ('332 × 345 t+2.45s') and dotted placeholder lines with dark dot end-caps. Each card fills in with a soft blur-to-sharp wipe that moves downward, left card first. The bpm number changes 72 → 77. From 2.2 to 2.45s everything blurs out and the canvas goes blank. Act 2 (2.6–5.5s) is one large centred Heart rate card [421,147,758,787]. Its skeleton is flanked by two monospace code panels: 'AGENT.LOG // PARTS 00/18' on the left, whose rows tick from [#####.] to [ ok ], and 'MOTION.CSS // 03 RECIPES' on the right, which types more CSS recipes. The card resolves top-down (72 bpm, red ECG trace, grid chart), and its digits roll before the card blurs away. Act 3 (5.95–9.6s) is a tall centred Token spend card [545,98,510,883] with the same log and CSS panels (PARTS 00/61 → 61/61). It resolves to a chart with 7 stacked bars in blue/purple/orange/green. A hand cursor then clicks 'Month' at ~8.7s: the pill slides, the totals change 1.7M → 6.9M, the x-axis changes to 1–30 and the legend values change. The cursor then hovers 'Year', and the card blurs out. Act 4 (9.9–15.33s) is a centred music player [460,144,672,790]. 1pa0up-aquarium-404-error-page.summary: A full-bleed dark 404 page (#151413 near-black with a faint dot grid and a soft diagonal light shaft from top-right) for "Living UI": logo + wordmark top-left, "Catalog" / "Pricing" grey links and a cream pill "Sign in" top-right, a centred large white headline "This page sank" (~y 200–280) over a two-line grey subline. The bottom third is an aquarium: a teal water body whose surface is a thin bright crest line spanning full width, with flat-illustrated seaweed fronds, red cartoon crabs, small fish (blue tang, clownfish, grey-green fish) and a sandy mound at the bottom; a dark pill "Hear the water" (muted speaker icon) sits bottom-right. Motion: at ~0.8s the water level rises ~76 px (crest y≈748 → ≈672) and fish appear while the pill flips to "Mute the water"; between 0.85–1.35s three big extruded cream 3D digits "4 0 4" drop in from above the frame, splash into the water at ~1.4–1.6s (droplets fly, surface bulges) and float half-submerged, the underwater parts tinted teal by the water. From ~1.8s the camera zooms out (with motion blur) to reveal the page in a Chrome window over a night-city desktop; 3–7s the window is shaken and the water sloshes in large refractive waves across the whole page, flinging droplets and tumbling the digits. ~7.5s it zooms back in to full page and through 19s the cursor (grab hand) fishes digits out and tosses them, so they bob and drift (reading "0 4 4" for a while) on a wavy surface, and the clip ends with the digits back near "4 0 4" floating at the waterline.

1r2vit-generative-ui-map-card.summary: A light chat transcript on a near-white page (#fafaf9/#fcfcfc), with a 1 px grey window edge on the top and left. It holds one centred column about 896 px wide (x 286 to 1182). The user's grey message bubble sits top right at [501,92,682,92], radius about 24, with a soft shadow and 20 px dark Inter-style text. Below it is the assistant reply, left-aligned at x 286, with 'Linden Park.' and 'The Boathouse' in bold. Under the reply is a generated map card at [286,311,896,538], radius about 22. It is a flat vector city map: a light-grey block grid with white streets on a slight rotation, and a green park rectangle holding a blue oval 'Linden Lake', a small pond, blob-shaped tree clusters and white paths. Pill labels sit on the map ('Fern & Fig 4 min', 'Lumen Coffee 9 min', 'The Boathouse 5 min'). The selected label is a dark pill; the others are white. A blue walking route with a haloed blue start dot runs to the selected pin. A white place card at the bottom of the map shows a photo thumbnail, name, star rating, subtitle, three icon features, a '‹ n / 3 ›' pager and a pale-blue 'Send to iPhone' pill. A second paragraph sits below the card. Motion: from 0.8 to 2.4 s the reply text streams in word by word as a blur fade. At about 1.8 to 2.5 s the map fades in, then at 2.5 to 3 s the labels, the route and the place card fade in. At 5.0 to 5.15 s the camera zooms in by about 1.15x, with motion blur. The cursor pages the place card from The Boathouse (1/3) to Fern & Fig (2/3) to Lumen Coffee (3/3), then taps the Fern & Fig pin. Each change swaps the dark selected pill and redraws the route. At 9.45 to 9.55 s the camera zooms back out. A round theme button at the map's top right opens a 5-swatch picker pill (Vivid, Earth, Autumn, Paper, Night). Each choice recolours the whole map, the route and the send pill. Night turns the ground near-black. Returning to Vivid at about 16.5 s spreads back as a soft-edged circular reveal. The picker closes. The camera zooms in again at 18.3 to 18.5 s. 'Send to iPhone' is clicked and goes to 'Sending...' with a spinner, then to '✓ Sent to iPhone'. The camera zooms out at 20.4 to 20.6 s.

1ip5at-ai-model-router-dashboard.summary: A single light dashboard card, "Model router", sits centred on a pale lavender-grey (#f0f0f5) canvas. The canvas has faint diagonal hairline stripes, two dashed vertical guides at x≈538 and x≈1183 that frame the card, and two solid hairlines at x≈169 and x≈1553. The card (≈543,163 → 1180,916, ~20px radius, soft drop shadow) has four parts. The header row holds the 18px title with an info icon, then a "chat-prod" select pill, a sliders icon and a close X. Below it is a white inset panel with the mono caption "BLENDED COST · LIVE POLICY", a big ~40px price "$0.0046" with "/ 1K tokens", a mono stats line, and a three-way COST / BALANCED / QUALITY segmented control. Under those, a flow graph: from a hollow GATEWAY node at the left, four soft-glow lines fan out on S-curves to Opus 5.5 (blue), GPT-6.1 Sol (green), Haiku 4.5 (violet) and Qwen3.5 9B (magenta), each ending in a dot, a label and a mono req/s rate. The second inset panel is a "Routes" table: four rows, each with a coloured dot, the model name, a mono provider tag, a mini share bar, then share, P50/P95, $/1K and errors. Under the table, a Fallback row has an orange toggle and two model selects. The footer has a kebab menu, a mono "POLICY V14 · LIVE ON CHAT-PROD" and a pale salmon "Deploy policy" pill. The layout never moves. Throughout the clip, small coloured dots stream left to right along every route line. A cursor drives the states. At ~2s it clicks COST: the white pill slides to COST, the price counts down to $0.0026, the caption turns green "▼ 44% VS LIVE", rates and shares change, the footer reads "UNSAVED CHANGES" and Deploy turns saturated orange. At ~4.5s it clicks QUALITY: the price climbs to $0.0089, a red "▲ 92% VS LIVE" appears, and the Opus line swells into a thick glow band. At ~6s BALANCED restores $0.0046 and the pale Deploy. From ~7 to 11s it hovers each graph label in turn; the hovered route stays vivid while the other lines and table rows fade to ~35%. At ~12s the Fallback toggle switches off (grey knob, faded selects). At ~14–15s and ~16–17s the fallback selects open a dropdown, "IF THIS MODEL FAILS", that lists four models with prices and a check mark.

uswizi-dither-ascii-stock-cards.summary: Two equal portrait cards sit side by side on a flat charcoal (#404040) ground: the left at x 90–690, the right at x 750–1350, both running y 78–1001 with square corners and a 60 px gutter. Each card has a white artwork panel on top (y 78–669, 600×591) and a solid footer below (y 669–1001). Left card: the footer is forest green #355f3a and holds the white sans label "Stock Card", the white serif title "NYC Exchange", a muted three-line description, a pin icon with "NYC, United States", three overlapping avatars with a dim "+30 more are watching", a white "Add Card" pill at the top right and a lighter green "Expand" button with a soft drop shadow at the bottom right. Right card: the footer is lavender #cecfe6 with indigo type: uppercase "MY CARD", the serif "Shanghai Stock Exchange", a grey description, an indigo "Shanghai, China", avatars with grey "+35 more are participating", the same white "Add Card" pill and a solid indigo #4e50cf "Expand" button. The left artwork is an ordered-dither field of green square dots on roughly a 6 px grid that forms a right-pointing chevron or arrow. The right artwork is a column-aligned ASCII rendering in blue-violet 0/1 glyphs of a person's silhouette in profile, laid over a faint blurred lavender haze. Both footers stay perfectly still for the whole 17.67 s. Only the two artworks move, and they move constantly. The green dither chevron breathes in a loop of about 2 s: it is a narrow arrow at 0 s and 2.05 s, swells to fill the panel with a white V-shaped crease at about 0.55 s and 2.5 s, then splits into a small left arrowhead and a large right crescent at about 1.5 s and 3.75 s. The ASCII figure shifts and re-renders as live video, and its glyphs flicker frame to frame. Nothing translates, scales or fades in the UI chrome.

1bjvs6-linkstore-404-page.summary: A white 1024x720 404 page, everything centred on x≈492. At the top is the Linkstore lockup: a 38px blue rounded-square app icon (a 2x2 grid of pale tiles, with the top-right tile replaced by a white up-right arrow) next to the bold black word "Linkstore" (y≈86–124). Below it is a search pill (348–640 x 207–252, white, hairline grey border, soft shadow, grey magnifier at left). Lower down is a bold ~30px black heading, "We couldn't find that page" (y≈405–440). Under that are two centred grey lines of body copy (y≈462–515), then a row with a solid royal-blue pill button, "Search the store" (#1937da, 285–468 x 567–613, white text), beside a plain black text link, "Go to the homepage". The only motion is a looping search demo. The small empty pill fades in at about 0.2s. From about 0.55s to 1.2s it grows into a larger pill (≈338–665 x 228–304). It moves down about 20px, its right end fades to transparent, the magnifier gets bigger and darker, and "nothing here" is typed in large black text, one letter after another. A faint dashed pill outline (a ghost result row) then appears below it at y≈322–350, also fading out to the right. It holds until about 3.9–4.1s, when the bar disappears. The small empty pill comes back at about 4.2s, and from 4.68s to 5.25s the same grow-and-type sequence repeats, then holds to the end. The heading, copy, buttons, logo and the parked cursor at (825,437) never move. At about 8.87s a dashed border flashes around the whole frame; this is a recording artifact.

1o59x5-dark-integrations-settings-panel.summary: A single dark settings card sits centred on a flat #2e2e2e canvas: an outer near-black (#0b0b0b) card at [149,180,782,720] with ~24px corners holds a header ("Integrations" in white ~28px, "Manage connected apps" in grey ~22px beneath, both left-aligned at x=189) and two inset #171717 panels separated by a ~5px black seam at y≈485: ACCOUNT (one row, Google) and APPS (three rows: Aave, Claude Code, Jupiter). Section labels are small, bold, widely letter-spaced grey caps, each followed by a hairline divider; rows are separated by hairlines. Each row is a 54px rounded app-icon tile at x=189, a white name (~24px) and a grey meta line "platform · status" at x=264, and a 62x35 amber pill toggle at x=830 whose knob is a black disc with a small amber centre dot sitting right when on; off is a dark grey pill with a dark knob on the left. Motion: from 0 to ~0.6s the card grows downward from a header-only strip (top fixed at 180, bottom from ~290 to 898) while the rows fade in from dim. Then a hand cursor clicks toggles in turn, each a state machine of toggle + meta text: Google (on → off "Disconnected" ~1.0–1.2s → "Connecting..." with a small grey spinner pushed in before the meta text ~1.4s → toggle back on → "Connected just now" ~1.8s), Jupiter (off → on, "Connecting..." 2.2–2.7s → "Connected just now" ~2.8s), Claude Code (off "Disconnected" ~3.4–3.6s → "Connecting..." ~3.8–4.2s → "Connected just now" ~4.3s), Aave (off "Disconnected" ~4.8–5.0s → "Connecting..." ~5.2–5.6s → "Connected just now" ~5.8s), and finally Jupiter is switched off and reads "Disconnected" from ~6.4s to the end. During a toggle's switch the pill passes through a dimmed brown-amber (#6a5831) state while the knob slides ~27px.

hl0uds-colorful-text-notes-concept.summary: An iPhone (dark graphite bezel, ~75px corner radius, dynamic island) sits centred on a near-black #080b0c stage with a faint radial vignette. The screen is a redesigned Apple Notes in dark mode, background #121315. The nav bar reads "< Notes" / "Next week plans" (semibold, centred) / "Done", and below it is a note of short paragraphs in SF-style 22px type with a 30px line height, left edge at x=262. Only the paragraph in focus is bright white. The others are dimmed to a dark grey, and paragraphs further from the focus are also progressively blurred (the top line and the bottom paragraph are soft). Inline words carry coloured text: "bigger" ochre, "smaller" teal, "Frame 2847" purple, "Rent" red, "Dentist" rose. Story: a cursor selects "nobody reads the case study." at ~1.8s (grey rounded selection bar, white drag handles). A dark, translucent rounded popover with a downward tail appears above the selection: a 3x3 grid of glossy colour orbs (white, red, yellow / green, teal, blue / violet, pink, a rainbow ring) and a list of recent highlights, each with a small coloured bar. Hovering the swatches tints the selection teal, then pink. The popover closes and the phrase stays pink (5.5s). The whole paragraph is then selected and cycled through purple, teal and green before returning to white (6–11s). At 11.05–11.4s focus moves to the "Ideas I'll never ship" paragraph: the text scrolls down ~120px and the bright/dim states swap. At 11.8–12.4s the camera zooms ~2x into the screen. "Frame 2847" is selected and the popover tints it red, then yellow; the highlight is a gradient bar fading to the right. The popover closes at ~15.6s, leaving "Frame 2847" yellow (16.2s). At 16.75–17.55s the camera zooms back out to the full phone, which holds to the end.

1ebgeo-minimal-portfolio-with-games.summary: A screen recording of a minimal, single-column typographic portfolio on pure white (#ffffff), seen through a recorder camera that zooms and pans to follow the cursor. Content column is left-aligned (~464–1445 px at the 0.5s overview): black name "Nexvyn", grey "Design Engineer", three grey Inter paragraphs with black inline links (reverse-engineer has a dashed yellow underline, the email is underlined grey), a faint "See more of my work on GitHub." line, then a handwritten "projects" heading with list/grid toggles. Fixed top-right chrome: a light-grey muted speaker icon and a solid black theme dot. Handwritten blue margin notes ("feel free to reach out" with a hand-drawn bracket, "← psst, it's a game" with a sheep sticker) appear beside the paragraphs. The story is a run of hover easter eggs: 0–1s the text fades in line by line; ~2–3.5s hovering the name shows a smoky-edged anime avatar to its left; ~4–7.5s hovering "Design" turns it into a green handwritten word whose stem grows into an embroidered-looking bouquet that blooms more flowers (4.85→5.35); ~8.5–9.5s hovering "Engineer" turns it blue and pins a textured blueprint card with a wrench; ~9.7–9.9 the camera pulls back; ~10.8–11.5 hovering GitHub scribbles the word out and pops a white rounded card with a 12×7 green contribution grid and "@nexvyn · 2,341 contributions this year"; ~12–13.6 that card grows into a teal-framed preview and then a full-frame pixel-art top-down game (knight "NEXVYN", towers, river, sheep, "Pat the sheep" prompt) that plays until ~15.85 and cross-dissolves back to the page by ~16.05. The projects list follows: "runeicons ★660" with a heavily blurred preview card and a blue app icon, which on hover (~19–20s) sharpens to a product screenshot; "nexvyn/ui ★225"; "rynix studio" card; a handwritten "mind" section whose row gets a light grey pill on hover (22.5→23). At ~24.5s clicking the black dot floods the page dark (#0b0b0b) with a circle from the dot, a tooltip "Nexvyn prefers light mode" shows, and at ~26.8s a white circle grows back from the dot to restore light; from ~27.8s the page scrolls to an illustrated lotus pond that fades up from white at the bottom.

q6117m-drawing-app-toolbar-blur.summary: A four-shot product film of a drawing app's tools, each shot a slow camera drift over a white UI surface in steep perspective on an off-white (#fbfbfa) background. A strong depth-of-field blur keeps only a central band sharp; the ends of every surface melt into soft blur. Shot 1 (0–3.0s): a long white rounded toolbar pill with a small grey grabber at the top. From left to right it holds two blurred round buttons, three white 3D marker pens (chisel, round and wide tip, labelled "58"), a 2×3 grid of colour discs (brown, blue, green / yellow, red, colour wheel) and two blurred round icons at the right. A hand cursor taps yellow at about 0.7s: the selection ring leaves brown and lands on yellow, and the pens' tips and bands turn from brown to yellow. The cursor then taps the third pen, which slides up about 50px while the first pen sinks. Hard cut at 3.0s. Shot 2 (3.0–6.4s): a tilted paper card shows the handwritten quote "Trying to define yourself is like trying to bite your own teeth." – Alan Watts, with a pale yellow mark under the second line. A grey tray below has the tabs "Highlight", "Underline" and "Overline", and a dark pen-stroke indicator steps from Highlight to Underline to Overline. Hard cut at 6.4s. Shot 3 (6.4–8.85s): the card, tilted the other way, shows "There's advertisements on my eyelids, free trials in the air I breathe" – Maxwell Davis, with taupe highlight blocks. An "Opacity" slider drawn as a zig-zag spring stretches right until its value reads "1.00", and the highlight gets darker. Hard cut at 8.85s. Shot 4 (8.85–11.42s): "Hatred is too strong of an emotion to waste on someone you don't like." – Sixto Rodriguez sits above a row of six crayon-scribble swatches (yellow, orange, pink, sky blue, green, light blue). A hand-drawn brown circle marks the chosen swatch, and the cursor moves it orange → pink → blue. Each time, the highlight behind the quote takes the new colour. Type is a brown-black handwriting script for the quotes and grey sans for the UI labels; corners are large and rounded.

1s5qn0-minimal-ai-chat-composer.summary: A single wide AI chat composer sits centred on a flat #f7f7f7 page. It is two layers: a light grey tray (#ececec, about 1456x421 at x107 y333, corners about 48px) and, on top of it, a near-white input card (#fdfdfd, 1452x320, corners about 48px, 1px #dedede hairline and a soft drop shadow). The card holds a light grey 36px placeholder, "Start by typing...", at top left. Its bottom row has a thin "+", a "Request approval" chip with a hand icon, and on the right a model selector "Auto ⌄", a mic outline and a 65px grey circular send button with a white up-arrow. Below the card the tray shows three small brand marks (Gmail M, Slack, ClickUp) and grey "Connect apps". The type is a neutral grotesk (Inter-like). The motion is a cursor-driven demo. (1) Around 2.6s the chip switches to a pink pill with red text, "Unrestricted access", and a shield icon. (2) Clicking Auto fades in a white dropdown (radius about 40, soft shadow) above the selector. It overlaps the card and has three rows: Auto (sparkle icon, check), Claude (orange asterisk) and ChatGPT (OpenAI knot), each with a grey subtitle. Hovering Claude gives that row a #f2f2f2 rounded highlight. Choosing it about 3.4s fades the menu out, and the selector reads "✳ Claude ^". (3) The menu reopens about 4.4s with Claude checked, and ChatGPT is chosen about 5.2s. (4) About 5.9s the mic is clicked. The selector, mic and send give way to a dotted waveform that fills with bars from the right, plus two 64px rounded-square buttons (×, ✓) with a hairline border. Grey dictated text builds word by word into "Draft a short update for the". (5) About 8.5s ✓ is clicked. The text turns near-black, "Draft a short update for the team", with a caret. The controls return, and the send circle turns black. (6) About 11.1 to 11.45s the bottom "Connect apps" strip goes away and a "Select a project" strip with a blue folder icon opens at the top of the tray. The white card slides down about 97px (top 335 to 432) while the tray's outer box stays at 333 to 753. (7) About 12.35s send is clicked. The text clears back to the placeholder and the send circle goes back to grey.

l9y2vy-expanding-search-interaction.summary: A single control sits alone on a flat warm off-white page (#f4f3ef), centred horizontally near the top third. At rest it is a 112 px circular search button: a white rim with a hairline grey edge and a soft diffuse drop shadow, holding a 90 px warm-grey disc (#ebe9e4) with a dark magnifier glyph. On click (0.45–1.0 s) the circle stretches symmetrically left and right into a 542 px pill search bar (x 237–779, top fixed at y 137) whose inner grey field shows the magnifier at left, a blue text caret, placeholder 'Search components' in light grey and a grey × at right; at the same time a white results panel (radius ~40 px, same width, soft shadow) drops from a thin pill under the bar down to y 610, and its four rows ('Action Button', 'Toast', 'Code Input', 'Segmented Control', ~27 px dark sans, 81 px pitch) slide/blur into place in a stagger, the first row covered by a fully rounded warm-grey highlight pill. From 1.6 to 3.2 s the cursor hovers down the list and the highlight pill glides (not jumps) between rows: Toast, Code Input, Segmented Control, then back to Action Button. At ~4.2 s typing 't' re-filters the list with a blurred cross-fade: matching letters turn bold black while the rest of each name goes mid-grey, and the panel grows to five rows (Toast, Tab Bar, Action Button, Quantity Stepper, Invite Field, bottom ~698); typing 'o' (~4.5 s) narrows it to three rows (Toast, Hold to Confirm, Action Button) and the panel shrinks to y ~528. Hovering the × shows a small round grey hover disc; clicking it (~6.0 s) clears the field and the original four rows blur back in (panel bottom back to 610). At ~7.05–7.25 s the panel retracts upward into the bar and the bar contracts back into the 112 px circle, ending where it began.

1dts93-neumorphic-rich-text-editor.summary: A soft, light-grey neumorphic editor (background ~#eeeeef with a faint top-to-bottom grey gradient) centred in a 960x720 frame. At rest, a wide floating toolbar pill (≈734x80, radius ≈24, soft drop shadow below, white top highlight) sits at y≈160. Inside it on the left is an inset-raised dropdown pill "Body 2" with a chevron. To its right is a row of thin, light-grey glyph buttons: B, I, U and a link, then a glossy dark-grey sphere (colour swatch), then three alignment glyphs, of which align-left is dark (active) and centre/right are light. Below it a six-line Inter paragraph (~19px, 37px line pitch) starts at x≈165, y≈286. Its ink fades from dark grey on lines 1–3 to near-invisible on line 6. A small white chip on the far left (x≈43, y≈286) labels the state: "idle", "selection", "menu", "carry", "done". The clip tells a cut-and-paste story, with a virtual camera that zooms and pans. 0.85–2.9s: the camera eases in about 1.3x toward the text. An I-beam drags a pink highlight across ", guided by clear standards", with a black "Select" pill under the cursor. About 3.1s: a frosted context menu (Cut / Copy / Paste with icons) pops above the selection. At 4.8s, hovering Cut shows a "Cut ⌘ + X" tooltip. 5.65–7.7s: the camera pushes in further and a dashed rounded outline appears around the selection, while a black scissors cursor travels along the dashed line. 8.7–9.2s: the pink clipping lifts off and tilts about −10°, leaving an empty dashed slot. 9.3–11.1s: the clipping straightens and floats with a shadow, and the gap closes as the text reflows to "any number of applications. What's the". 11.25–14.55s: the camera pans right as the clipping is dragged with a black "Move" pill and dropped after "component". About 15.4s: a "Select all / Paste" menu appears, and "Paste ⌘ + V" shows on hover at 15.9s. 16.2–17.4s: the clipping tilts down into the line, which now reads "components, guided by clear standards". 18.35–20.25s: the camera zooms back out to the original framing and the chip reads "done". About 22s: the paragraph fades away, leaving only the toolbar and the chip.

72xxyw-dark-fintech-card-animation.summary: Two dark feature cards sit side by side, vertically centred on a near-black (#0c0c0c) stage: a narrower "Transaction Messaging" card on the left (x128–670, y276–803) and a wider "Document Management" card on the right (x685–1516, y268–811). Both are #131313 slabs with ~40px radius and a faint 1px lighter rim, a title in white ~22px and a two-line grey description at the bottom-left. Each holds a recessed demo panel (#181818, ~24px radius) whose bottom edge fades into the card. The left panel is a chat on a faint dot grid: a centred pill "Request created and Escrow funded", a right-aligned "You" bubble and a left-aligned "John Doe" bubble. The right panel is a window mock with three grey traffic-light dots, then an inner darker list titled "Documents" with rows (checkbox, grey file icon, filename, date, kebab) separated by a hairline; a third row "KY-8453.pdf" fades out under a bottom mask. Motion is a looping ~8s demo: at the start the card titles and descriptions resolve from a word-by-word blur reveal (~0–1s); chat bubbles fade in while rising ~10px (You first, John Doe ~2.3s), a small green arrow cursor glides in the documents list toward the W-2 row, then to the first row's checkbox, which turns green-checked (~4.5s); a second green cursor wanders in the chat panel; around 7–8s the chat bubbles fade out while drifting down and the checkbox clears, and the cycle replays (empty chat at ~8–10.5s, bubbles back by ~11–14s). Card frames, titles and list text never move.

193du9-minimal-serif-portfolio-hero.summary: A full-bleed portfolio page on near-white (#fdfdfd) with a thin pale-blue gradient strip across the top (y 0–36). The hero is one left-aligned column starting at x 321: a 1044×587 photo of the Upper East Side skyline above a park (x 321–1365, y 118–705) drawn as a halftone grid of round dots, about 64 columns × 36 rows at a 16 px pitch. The dots are ~15 px wide and almost touch, so the gaps between them read as small four-point stars. Below it sits a two-line dark serif headline, "I'm designing software for the world on your / screen, inspired by the one outside my window." (y ~755–855, ~44 px), then a two-line grey sans bio (y ~888–942, ~19 px). In the bio, "David Luft" is underlined by a row of 11 small dots coloured from the scene. To the right of the image (x 1402) is a small sans sidebar: "Scene →", "Backdrop" with a small rounded-rectangle icon, then light-grey metadata ("Upper East Side", date and time, then Wind / Cars / People with right-aligned values at x ~1532). Motion: at 0–0.5 s the page fades in. The photo starts as a soft blurred pale image with a grey headline, then resolves into the dot grid by ~1 s while the bio and sidebar fade in. The scene then cycles, and each change crossfades every dot's colour and updates the date line: 6/20 10:04 AM sunny → 7/6 4:45 PM overcast (~3 s) → 6/18 5:23 PM (~5 s) → 7/3 8:30 PM dusk (~7.5 s) → back to 6/20 10:04 AM by ~11 s. The Wind/Cars/People numbers keep ticking, and dots flicker locally (cars and people moving) while the scene holds. At 6.0 s, clicking Backdrop fills its icon solid black and turns the star-shaped gaps between dots near-black. Between 10.05 and 10.45 s the whole page scales to ~0.82 into a rounded white window card (x 62–1625, y 63–1016, radius ~16) floating on a soft sky-blue gradient. At ~12.5–14 s an About modal (grey scrim, white card with a round portrait) opens and closes. From 15.25 s the page scrolls up ~560 px to show a project card ("Site management at scale" with a green-framed app screenshot), and from ~18 s it moves into a product demo.

4063qa-chatsheet-automation-landing-page.summary: A full-page scroll recording of the Chatsheet marketing site at 1502x1080. Light grey (#f4f5f7) and near-white (#fcfcfd) bands alternate. Thin vertical guide lines run at x≈33 and x≈1469, and 1px hairlines separate the sections. All type is dark navy (#0c1632). Headings use a book serif (large, regular weight), body copy and buttons use a grotesque sans, and every primary action is a blue (#4375f7) pill labelled "Book a Free Discovery". Page order: a sticky-looking top nav (logo left; How it Works / Use Cases / Become a Partner / Partners centred; white "Book a Free Call" pill right). Then a centred hero ("Turn Manual Tasks / into Automations", a two-line grey subline, blue and white pills) over an isometric illustration: a blue concentric-ring hub, app tiles flowing along a dotted path into it from the lower left, and result cards with blue pills ("Automation Action", "Strategy Content", "Personal…") stepping off to the upper right. Next come three alternating text/illustration rows ("01. You Tell Us What You Do", "02. We Design Automations", "03. You Scale Without Busywork") with grey numerals and lavender isometric platforms. Then a centred "Examples of What You Can Automate With Chatsheet" grid (3 cells over 2) with small line-art illustrations; an "Enterprise-Grade Automation, 100% Done-for-You" band of three illustrated features; a white "Ready to Save Hours Every Week?" CTA with app icons in glass discs on concentric rings at the right; and a footer with a large centred logo, three links and a copyright line. Motion: the page scrolls down in five eased strokes with short holds (kf 2.5, 4.85, 7.45, 10). After each stroke the page creeps another ~30–40px. It holds on the footer from ~12.65 to 14.15s, then scrolls back to the top from 14.15 to 16.8s and rests on the nav and hero until 17.97s. The page's own small animations run throughout: hero app tiles creep along the dotted path toward the hub, section 01 swaps which app tile sits in its slot, and the CTA's icon discs drift along their rings.

ti5i8b-vercel-agents-homepage-redesign.summary: A Vercel-style hero on a 1482x1080 canvas. A slim nav bar runs along the top (black Vercel triangle at x 127, links Products ▾ / Resources ▾ / Enterprise / Pricing, then three pill buttons on the right: Get a Demo, Log In and a filled Sign Up ending at x 1334). The left column, aligned at x≈127, holds a two-line tight-tracked headline, "Build and run / agents on Vercel" (~56px, y 298–402), a two-line grey subhead and two pill CTAs: a filled "Create an agent" and an outlined "Talk to an expert". The right half shows an isometric 3D cube drawn as a hexagon (box ≈803,347,352,320). It has three rounded rhombus faces, top, lower-left and right, separated by gaps. Six thick black chevron frame segments sit around them, and a faint hexagonal halo and a soft drop shadow sit underneath. A small white Vercel triangle sits on the top face. Above the cube are two chat bubbles joined to it by hairline connectors: a user bubble "@data-agent How did revenue trend last quarter by region?" at the top right, and an agent reply bubble with a small robot avatar circle to its left. Along the bottom, a four-column stat row (4T+, 3×, 1M+, < 5 min; ~56px light-weight numerals at y≈858, two-line grey captions at y≈930) starts at x 126/434/741/1048. Motion: a cursor moves over the cube. The face under the cursor lightens to a soft grey gradient, and an annotation fades in (~200 ms) with a short hairline leader, a bold title and a 3-line grey caption: Connect (bottom-left, ~0.2–1.0s), Sandbox (right, ~1.0–1.7s), eve (top-left, ~1.8–2.4s), Drives (left, ~2.5–3.2s). From ~3.3s nothing is annotated. At ~4.1s the page hard-cuts from light (#f7f7f7 bg, near-black type) to dark (#000 bg, white type, buttons inverted). The cube becomes outline-only: black faces with thin grey stroked edges and outlined frame segments. In dark mode, hovering the lower-left face lights it and brings back Connect (~5.1–5.9s), which then fades as the cursor leaves. The layout never moves; only the hover highlights, annotations, cursor and theme change.

1t92dp-skeuomorphic-image-compressor-mac.summary: A white page at 1440x1080 with one centred column. At the top is a photoreal retro compressor machine (box ~[425,178,590,230]): a warm-grey plastic body, a brushed-metal top deck with a dark LCD window, a blue knurled metal knob and a small red-orange push button, and a long horizontal feed slot across the front. Below it is a drop zone with no border, drawn as a faint grey dot grid on a 24 px pitch that fades out at its edges (~[445,440,545,270]). It holds two centred lines: "Drop your image here" (~22 px, near-black) and "or click browse files" (~18 px, mid-grey). At the bottom centre (y≈924–1004) is a segmented pill control: a light-grey capsule track holding a grey "Compress" pill with a white compress glyph and white text, next to a white "Size" pill with black text. To the right of the drop zone, a photo card (a woman with windswept red hair against a blue sky, in a green top) rests tilted about −4°, with rounded corners, a soft drop shadow and a small white image-icon badge at its top left. Motion: from 1.9 s to 2.6 s the cursor drags the card left about 460 px until it sits centred under the machine. Around 3.0 s the card vanishes, the drop-zone text blurs out, and "Size" rolls to "58KB" with a blur. By 3.45 s the photo hangs from the slot inside a frosted, translucent white plastic sleeve with soft diagonal sheen stripes, and the sleeve lengthens to y≈790 by 3.75 s. From about 4.5 s to 5.5 s the Compress pill turns black (pressed). From about 6 s to 9.5 s the sleeve vacuum-shrinks: the plastic wrinkles, the photo pinches in at its sides and warps, and the bottom edge turns ragged. Around 10.5 s an orange glow runs along the left of the slot and the value rolls from 58KB to 21KB. upmtie-agents-platform-hero.summary: A centred, single-column hero on an off-white page (#fcfcfc). From the top: a small orange outline four-point spark with four short yellow-orange rays (centre ~404,92), a dark sans heading "A faster path to production AI" (~26px, centred at y≈175), and a two-line grey subtitle (~25px, lines at y≈222 and y≈263). Below sits a near-square stage panel (64,337 → 743,1015, fill #fafafa, 1px very light border, tiny notched corners) with a 3px orange-red dot just outside each corner. Centred in the panel at y≈676 is a white fully-rounded terminal pill with a soft drop shadow holding the orange Cloudflare cloud, a grey "$", dark monospace "npm" and orange monospace "i agents" with an orange block cursor. Motion: at 0s the pill is only an ~82px white circle around the cloud; by ~0.45s it has stretched sideways into the full ~378px pill; the command then types out character by character ("n" at 0.5s, "npm i a" at 0.8s, "npm i agen" at 1.0s, "npm i agents" at 1.3s). At ~1.3–1.4s a puff of tiny coloured specks bursts from the middle of the pill, and by ~1.8s it has become a ring of ~40 white circular logo bubbles (AI and tool brands: Google, Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Cloudflare, Zed, Replit-style R and so on) around the pill. From ~1.8s to the end (12.37s) those bubbles fill the whole panel and keep drifting, as if a grab-hand cursor were dragging them, at roughly 150–250 px/s. Bubbles grow and shrink as they move: most are 50–90px, but at any moment a few swell to 150–220px. They are clipped by the panel edges and can slide over the pill. The header, subtitle, panel and pill never move.

1eucu6-paper-plane-scroll-toc.summary: A single "On this page" table of contents sits left-of-centre on a flat near-black (#101010) page, with no card or panel behind it. A three-line hamburger icon and the grey heading "On this page" (about 34px sans, x 712, y 160) sit above eight entries. There are three indent levels: Installation, Usage and Features at text x 709 with node x 668; Prerequisites, Installation Steps, Configuration and Customizing Content at x 748 with node x 708; Submenu Content at x 788 with node x 747. The rows are spaced 89–90px apart, from y 286 to 913. One continuous rail joins the nodes. It runs straight down within each level and takes short 45° diagonals where the indent changes, and a short lead-in stub rises above Installation. Before the indicator reaches a part of the rail, that part is a faint grey dashed line and its nodes are hollow grey rings (~18px, ~3px stroke). Once passed, that part becomes a solid grey ~3px line and its nodes become filled grey dots (~20px). The indicator is a flat white paper-plane dart (~34×40px, notched tail, no outline, no shadow). It flies along the rail, rotating to point the way it travels: down on the verticals, diagonal on the slants, and up/back when the reader scrolls back up. The active section's label turns bright white (~#f0f0f0) and the previously active one fades back to mid grey (~#8a8a8a). In the clip the plane flies from Installation down through every entry to Features (~0–5.4s), returns up to Installation (~6–9.6s), and after a layout cut at ~9.8s (whole TOC shifts down ~23px) flies down again (~10–15.5s), then back and forth for the rest. Each hop between neighbouring entries takes ~0.4–0.6s, and the solid line fills in behind the plane. The mouse cursor stays mostly parked near (1020, 612).
